sentences.text: Chapter 1138: The beginning is always difficult.
At first, when Victor activated the ritual and used himself as a battery, he found everything incredibly strange.
His reserves were immense, a level of energy that could sustain several planets with ease.
Even using all his power, he would not become tired.
But only 7 weeks after the ritual was activated, he began to feel signs of fatigue.
You see, it’s not that he was tired, but that he was showing signs that he could become tired.
Which was ridiculous!
If there was one thing he had absolute confidence in, it was his energy.
After all, he was not just a dragon god, he was the progenitor of this new race that was the perfect fusion of a dragon and a vampire.
Not to mention that he had control over countless world trees throughout this entire sector, and each of them provided energy to him in exchange for Victor nurturing them with his energies.
He was also an outer god!
Not to mention that he was not sustaining the entire ritual on his own.
His wives were sharing the burden with him.
With him, Jeanne, and Natalia being the ones who have taken on the heaviest burdens.
As the strongest energy batteries, Victor took on the greatest burden, followed by Jeanne, considering that, in terms of pure energy, she only loses to Victor.
Natalia, as a goddess of time, took on the burden of controlling the time of the ritual, and therefore cannot lose her concentration.
When she was getting tired, his wives intervened and helped ease the burden.
After all, not all of them were helping at the same time.
They are participating in a rotation format, since some of them need to descend into their avatars to assist in the development of the Empire.
The only ones who are always present are Jeanne and Victor, who were essentially acting as anchors for the ritual.
And even so, he showed signs of becoming tired!
He completely underestimated the energetic scale of this project.
He was spending more energy than he was producing, and that was ridiculous considering all his powers.
But thinking deeply about the matter, he understood the problem.
Essentially speaking, ALL the changes that are occurring within the ritual are spending his energy.
Time passing faster, the actions of all beings, the rotation of the planet, the solar system itself, absolutely everything consumed energy.
Because Victor was not just accelerating the development of the planet, he was accelerating the development of the entire Milky Way, and that is where the problem lies.
In fact, the simple fact that it took so long for him to feel even minimal energetic wear proves how absurd his energy reserves are, and those of his wives.
Victor predicts that if someone were to replace him, someone like Violet or Sasha, for example, would, despite being draconic goddesses, just die from activating the ritual.
Fortunately, Victor was adaptable.
Upon identifying the problem, he immediately ceased all unnecessary energy expenditure and began meditating.
He focused all his attention on the ritual and on energy recovery.
Near the center of the Milky Way, inside the imperial ship, Victor and Jeanne were sitting in a meditative pose in an empty room.

As the energy emanating from the two was so powerful, they had to move as far away from the edge of the Galaxy as possible and go straight to the center, or they could risk their own emanated power affecting the surrounding Galaxies, causing complications that would require Victor’s help to correct.
Kaguya, Sasha, and Nyx observed their husband with neutral but somewhat worried expressions.
They were constantly keeping an eye on him, with Sasha being a permanent resident, always watching Victor.
Meanwhile, the others rotated between going to the Empire to help in its development and spending energy on the ritual to ease the burden on Jeanne, Victor, and Natalia.
"Who will descend now?" Sasha asked.
"Nyx and I.
We will create the third legion of the Empire." Kaguya replied.
"The secret police?"
"Yes." Kaguya nodded.
Regardless of the nation, it was a fact that they all needed a force that dealt with intelligence and counterintelligence.
After all, unstable elements were always common within a nation, no matter how perfect it was.
This was no exception for Victor’s Empire.
Even though the control of the Imperial family was enormous, there would still be those dissatisfied or too ambitious for their own good.
Even if the number was very small because everyone understood how powerful the Imperial family was, it still exists...
Especially on the side of the lesser gods of the allied pantheons.
Even if Kali and Amaterasu tried to control these elements, it was impossible to contain everything.
In the end, an intelligence force was necessary as these individuals could always disappear and serve as an example.
"Tsk, they have everything, low taxes, better education, better entertainment, even a place to grow stronger, and even so, there will be people like that, huh," Sasha complained.
"It is the nature of a being to always want more.
They are never satisfied." Nyx spoke in a tone of disdain.
These actions are nothing new to her.
The imperial family controlled everything in the Empire, and the economy was one of them.
There was no such thing as an unstable economy or generalized inflation, because they were the ones who provided the supplies.
There was an entire logistics system to control resource expenditures.
They cannot give too many resources, or the products will have no value, and the population will become lazy.
They also cannot give too few resources, or the population will become dissatisfied and rebellious, and seeds of rebellion may be born.
Just thinking about it, Sasha felt a headache. ’Who said ruling was easy?
Fortunately, my sisters and my daughter Akasha are competent.’
In any case, if any god becomes too bold, they could always send a dragon, a leviathan, or even Kaguya’s assassins to deal with them and serve as an example.
Two white lights materialized near the women, and soon Violet and Scathach appeared.
"Any progress?" Sasha asked.
"Yes, the legions were created, and the Empire is beginning to expand...
The goddesses of fertility, sex, marriage, and love are practically vibrating with excitement." Violet commented at the end, with a slight air of displeasure.
Thanks to her senses, she can see, smell, and feel too much.
Staying on the planet has become unbearable.

Led by Aphrodite, the goddesses with these concepts bathed the Empire with their divine influences, and as Aphrodite herself was empowering these blessings, even the highest-level gods were affected...
The consequence is obvious: they are procreating like rabbits.
In fact, that analogy was an offense to the rabbit itself.
Rabbits were shy and only had between 6 and 12 offspring per litter, but the individuals of the Empire were bathed by the influence of these goddesses?
15 to 20 children was the norm.
Of course, these children did not come from a single woman.
Due to the expansion propaganda, the Harem had become something even more common in the Empire.
As long as you have the resources to support the partners, the Empire will not interfere in anything.

Combine this fact with a population that was much healthier than before due to the presence of gods and advanced technology, a monarchy that values useful individuals, and an environment where, if you strive enough, you will be rewarded.
It was not uncommon for ordinary people to receive small wealth.
And since basic necessities such as housing, water, and food are cheap, it was very easy to maintain a harem.
Not to mention that due to the blessing of fertility, a woman can have quintuplets and not suffer any negative impact on her body.
Violet saw a man with only 4 wives who had a total of 14 children at once since they all became pregnant at the same time.
And this man was ’shy’ compared to other men who have 7 to 10 wives.
Reverse Harem was also not uncommon, but due to the blessings of the goddesses, these women are practically pregnant throughout the entire year without rest.
Incredibly, they do not mind it at all.
Aphrodite was having too much fun spreading her influence and that of the goddesses under her command.
If I had not pulled her ear to make her avoid influencing the children and the long-lived races, the situation would have become bad." Scathach snorted.
"Isn’t Anna responsible for that?" Kaguya asked.
"Yes, but that event happened when Anna had left her avatar."
"I see...
Should we keep someone watching Aphrodite?"
"There is no need, I am sure she will not forget her lesson." Scathach’s eyes shone lightly as she smiled innocently.
"...." Everyone around felt a chill down their spine.
They were very aware of Scathach’s methods.
After all, at some point, all of them had suffered at the warrior’s hands.
"How are things with him?" Scathach asked.
"Stable, his body is no longer showing any signs of wear.
Roxanne and Amara reported that his inner world is also very stable...
But..." Sasha paused at the end.
"Is there any problem?" Scathach asked.
"It is not a problem with Victor.
It is a problem with the souls." Sasha commented.
Persephone and Lilith reported that the reincarnation cycle is not large and stable enough to handle the demand for souls.
Not to mention that the cities of the Underworld are becoming crowded.
We must create a more efficient system so that souls reincarnate and do not remain in the Underworld."
It was not as if wars were occurring in the Empire, but even so, death still occurred there.
Arrogant or overly bold people who challenge the tower in search of strength but do not prepare.
Deaths from natural causes, such as old age, accidents, homicides due to fights between relatives, or someone who woke up on a bad day.
All these deaths were not uncommon.
As gods, they could intervene and resurrect these souls, but life needs a cycle, a beginning, and an end.
A population where everyone was immortal would only lead to stagnation in the long term.
Yes, there were many very long-lived races, such as vampires, elves, spirits, and gods, but they were the minority.
Even a demigod lives only 300 to 500 years.

A human from the Empire can live up to 150 to 160 years with the body of a 60-year-old, thanks to the saturation of so many supernatural beings, and because of the planet’s own natural energy, which is very rich.
The technological methods to extend life were also not disclosed on purpose, since people need to die, that is the cycle of life.
Gods were also notified not to interfere too much among mortals in this regard.
Although the technology to extend life was not disclosed, it was not complicated, since aging was nothing more than cells dying from accumulated damage, something that could be easily resolved.
Medical technology was nearly perfect, diseases practically did not exist, and lost limbs were restored in an instant.
Violet thought about something for a few seconds and just sighed: "...
We have to redo the entire reincarnation system, don’t we?"
"Ugh." Everyone except Sasha grumbled.
"To be born in the Empire then, upon dying, be thrown into hell where your life will be evaluated according to the rules of the Empire.
Those with great deeds are rewarded with reincarnation in a stronger body and will stand by in Valhalla.
Those who followed the rules of the Empire immediately reincarnate into a new life as citizens of the Empire." A voice was heard.
The women look and see Hela approaching.
"Isn’t that basically the Norse system?" Nyx asked.
"Why mess with something that works?" She smiled.
"...." Well, they could not disagree with that logic.
"We should change the name of hell, choose something friendlier...
Hmm, how about: Emperor’s Rest, or following the dragon theme, Dragon Rest.
Underworld and hell are very aggressive names for an afterlife."
"Emperor’s Rest is a good choice, but it does not have to be that direct a name.
We can create a tale, something like those who die find themselves before the Emperor, and the worthy achieve their rest in a new spark of life." Sasha suggested.
"Hmm...
Names have power, so we will still need an official name for the afterlife." Nyx pointed out.
"...." The women looked at each other with tired expressions.
They were very bad at naming something new.
"This is when we need Ruby and Pepper," Violet grumbled.
Everyone nodded.
If there was anyone who was good at giving names, it was those two.
"Well, Ruby is busy; the only one available is Pepper.
Let’s see what she says." Violet focused on their connection and reached out to Pepper.
"Violet?" Pepper’s image appeared beside the women.
"Pepper, give me name ideas for the afterlife," Violet asked.
"Leave it to me!
Hmm...
I thought of three good names, Garden of Entropy, Emperor’s Eden, and The Capital of the After-World."
"As expected of Pepper." Everyone said at the same time.
"Hehehehe~" She laughed, satisfied, and then spoke enthusiastically: "I also thought of something cool, how about Soul Nexus?...
Although it does not match our theme very well, you know what?
Ignore it, I just saw that in an anime I was watching recently!"
"Actually, they are all good, but I vote for Emperor’s Eden, creating passages in the sacred scriptures will be easier." Hela pointed out.
"Actually, depending on the tone, all the names are good," Violet said.
"Indeed, but we are looking for a resting place, not a mythical name." Scathach reminded the women.
While the women were discussing, Sasha, who was silent, suddenly realized something.
"Wait, how do you have time to watch anime, Pepper?" Sasha narrowed her eyes.
"Aren’t you taking care of the cultural progression of the Empire?"
Fue?
Well..." Pepper visibly broke out in a cold sweat, then disappeared, saying, "I need to go, bye!"
"..." The women just shook their heads.
"Even being a mother, she does not change," Violet commented with a helpless smile.
"In a way, it is admirable to remain true to oneself for so long." Scathach smiled amusedly at her daughter.
"..." They could not deny those words.
"Let’s go with Emperor’s Eden then?" Kaguya said, looking at the Empress.𝕗𝕣𝐞𝐞𝘄𝐞𝚋𝚗𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗹.𝚌𝕠𝚖
"Yes." Violet nodded in agreement.
"What happens to the cities of hell then?" Sasha asked.
"We will not give them up, after all, they were created by Darling...
But we have to change hell...
Or create a new dimension." Violet said.
"It is easier to create a new dimension, a place where the worthy will go, a place where souls will be judged," Hela said.
"Actually, I think creating a new dimension for worthy warriors is useless." Nyx said and then pointed out: "After all, those worthy souls will join the squad of beings created by Darling."
"Symbolism is what matters, Nyx.
That symbolism is what unites the warriors even more," Hela said.
As an ancient Norse, she understood that very well.
"In fact, we should make a place for tired souls as well, a place where they can rest for as long as necessary and then go on their great new adventure...
Of course, only the most worthy, the heroes of the Empire, will go to that place."
"Agreed.
This matter will be left in your hands, Hela." Violet liked the idea very much.
"Ugh, I knew it." She grumbled, but still accepted the job.

Violet clapped once and said with a charming smile on her face: "We will keep hell for sinners and demonic creatures, create a new place for soul screening, a new dimension for the worthy, and a new dimension for tired souls to rest, very easy work."
Hela rolled her eyes.
Creating an afterlife for trillions of lives was not easy at all!
"The biggest problem is the soul system itself, the dimension is easy to make...
Preferably, I would like Darling’s help, since he is the greatest authority on souls in our pantheon." Hela said.
Before the women could say anything, they heard in their minds.
[I will help you, just prepare everything and leave the flow of souls to me.]
Hela looked at Victor floating with his eyes closed and smiled gently: "Thank you for the help, Darling."
[Always, My dear.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1139: Time to develop.
paragraphs: Chapter 1139: Time to develop.
Time outside the ritual passed extremely quickly from the perspective of the dragon gods, but the same could not be said for those who were inside the ritual.
Just as planned, Victor and his empresses acted actively with their avatars and were present in every important step of the Empire’s development.𝘧𝘳𝘦ℯ𝓌𝘦𝒷𝘯𝑜𝑣𝘦𝓁.𝒸𝘰𝓂

They were there when the first warrior managed to pass the 500th floor of the Tower of Challenges, Babylon. They were there when there was an explosive increase in the population, thanks to the blessings of Aphrodite and her subordinate goddesses.

Thanks to the blessing of the gods related to life, fertility, motherhood, and marriage, all beings, regardless of race, could become pregnant with just one shot, although this blessing was very partial. They clearly focused more on mortals than on races that had immortal lives. Races such as gods, vampires, spirits, etc., beings that could live forever. It’s not as if they didn’t exist, but compared to the Empire, they were very few.

The reason for this was that no one in the Imperial family wanted the majority of their citizens to be immortal. The reason for this was varied, but the main point was that the circle of life must continue: birth, life, death, and reincarnation. In this way, they can shape the population to be loyal only to the Empire.

Another important reason was boredom. Ancient Greek goddesses who were on the Empire’s side understood this very well. With the passage of time, long-lived beings grow bored with everything and lose motivation. This behavior was harmful to the Empire in the long term and could lead to destructive behaviors.

Just look at Scathach’s actions before meeting Victor, and the actions of the goddesses themselves. Boredom leads people to seek something to do, and many of those things can be harmful to society itself. Imagine a population of trillions of immortal beings? That was hell on Earth.

Life must have a beginning, middle, and end, so that the feeling of ’new’ can always be present. Because of that, those who died do not have memories of their past life, only having a feeling that they belonged as citizens of the Empire. Except for those who had achieved great deeds for the Empire, most would have their memories erased and would have a new beginning.

That was not the only thing. Slowly and surely, Velnorah and Victor began a project to evolve the races. Humans became primordial humans, becoming much stronger than ordinary humans. Even children of this race can easily lift a building.
New vampires and new werewolves returned to the ancestral state. Now they no longer need to ’awaken’ to use their powers like the Count Vampire form that Victor and his vampire wives have.

Bloodlines grew stronger, bloodlines mixed, and, unlike before, with the presence of life gods monitoring and the Empire’s superior technology brought by Velnorah, there were no bloodline problems. Hybrids of various races were common in the 30,000 millennium of the imperial calendar.
At that time, humanity had already spread throughout their entire mother galaxy. The planets that had world trees began to be populated, and the population became interplanetary.

There were several means of transportation between planets, but the most common were the teleports that exist on each planet or the spaceships that use the same principle. When a civilization masters space and time, the concept of distance becomes irrelevant.
With the blink of an eye, you could be in Yggdrasil, and with another blink, you could be on the slightly more distant planets located on the edges of the galaxy.
Each new planet had a new Tower of Challenges, a copy of Babylon that was placed to encourage everyone to surpass their limits.
These towers created a large interconnected system. If an explorer enters the tower of Yggdrasil and another enters the tower of a distant solar system, they will still meet on the same floor.

Each floor was gigantic, capable of reaching the size of the old Earth or the size of a mega-planet. The floors were expanded and reduced automatically according to the size of the challengers in each of them.

Thanks to the Tower of Challenges, the culture around the Empire grew to become a culture of warriors. However, unlike ancient societies that valued only warriors, within the Empire everyone knew how to respect one another because each had a role to play for the Emperor.

Another group of beings that were loving this new era were the gods of the other pantheons. They were not like Victor, who was loyal to his wives. As long as they felt desire, they spread their seeds everywhere, sleeping with anyone who was interested in them. And with the superior technology of the Empire and powerful dragon gods...
Bloodline problems were no longer the norm, which means that... Demigods spread like plagues.
In the 30,000 millennium, harems were something common. As long as the individual had resources and could support their wives or husbands, everything was allowed.
It was truly a divine era, where gods and mortals walked without conflicts. More than 30 thousand years of development passed, and during that time, the legions of the Empire began to appear.
The first legions appeared at the beginning of year 20 of the Imperial calendar, specifically two legions.

Created by the goddesses Ariel, Kaguya, Nyx, Leona, and Tasha. The Sixth Legion: The Silent Judgment. This legion was responsible for applying Imperial law in any newly acquired territory. They usually act together with the third legion. If the third legion was the justice of the shadows, the sixth legion was justice in the light.
Sixth Legion: The Silent Judgment.
Function: Execution, punishment, and cleansing of corrupted or rebellious planets, maintaining order within the Empire at any cost.
Responsible for: judging, applying absolute laws, and eradicating heresies at first sight.
Common units: Elite soldiers, executioners, inquisitors, mind readers, empathic beings capable of feeling emotions, etc.
Internal slogan: "Heresy will not be tolerated."
Current Commander: Jeanne Elderblood, with Leona acting as her substitute when Jeanne is busy.

Just like the sixth legion, the third was created soon after by Nyx, Kaguya, and Persephone; this legion was made to operate in the shadows; the dirty work of the Empire would fall into their hands in ’most cases’.
Third Legion. The Black Hand of the Emperor. Or, as it is called, B.H.E.
Function: Intelligence, espionage, infiltration, and psychological warfare, etc.
Responsible for: Hunting traitors, destabilizing enemies, controlling the imperial narrative, etc.
Most common units: Shadow assassins, telepaths, shapeshifters, shadow demons, etc.
Internal slogan: "No one sees what bleeds in the dark."
Current Commander: Kaguya Elderblood, with Nyx acting when Kaguya is busy.
The 3rd and 6th legions act as the police and the secret service of the Empire, but these were not the only legions created.

In the 50th year of the Imperial calendar, Ruby, Velnorah, Natalia, and Alice descended in their avatars and decided to unify all the knowledge of the Empire. On that day, the fourth legion called Stellar Arsenal was created. This legion was also responsible for acquiring and studying future alien knowledge.
Fourth Legion: Stellar Arsenal
Function: Research, development, and control of super weapons and forbidden technology.
Responsible for: Creating weapons of mass destruction on the scale of solar systems and beyond, genetic experiments, temporal manipulation, etc.
Most common units: scientists, engineers, witches, and automatons to deal with more dangerous experiments, etc.
Internal slogan: "Progress at any cost."
Current Commander: Ruby Elderblood, with Velnorah or Aline acting as commander when Ruby is not available.

With only these 3 legions, most of the systems of the Empire were organized, but the protection of the Imperial family was still necessary. Therefore, the Imperial Guard was expanded and became the fifth legion.

Created personally by the Emperor, this legion contained the best of the best. It was made to protect the Emperor’s family, as well as the fervent faithful of the Empire. Each sacred temple had at least 3 to 5 units protecting it.

They were often called Sacred Guards by the most fervent faithful. And even though it seemed there were only a few protecting the sacred temples, they were the best of the best. Only one of them was enough to deal with most threats. Five, in most cases, was an exaggeration.
Because of its extremely important function, this was one of the legions that had fewer common units and more elite units. These elite units could be sent to any legion if support was needed.
Fifth Legion: The Imperial Guard.
Function: Personal defense of the Imperial Family, the faithful, and sacred relics.
Responsible for: Protecting Victor, his wives, daughters, and places considered sacred.
Most common units: Elite warriors handpicked by the Emperor or Empress.
Internal slogan: "We protect the hope of the Empire."
Current Commander: Nero Elderblood, Ophis Elderblood, Rose Elderblood when Nero and Ophis are not present.
In the 1000th year of the Imperial Calendar, two new legions were created, respectively the 1st and the 2nd legion.
First Legion: Spartan Legion.

Backstory: named in honor of the famous Spartans, this legion was created by Aphrodite together with Scathach and Rose, and trained personally by Scathach and Rose to invade, conquer, and secure everything for the Empire. If a battle happened, this legion would be the first to enter combat.
Function: Direct attack, invasion, and large-scale offense.
Responsible for: Conquering planets, breaking stellar defenses, and leading campaigns against external enemies.
Most common units: war dragons, armored soldiers, siege mages, spaceships capable of exploding planets and solar systems, etc.
Internal slogan: "We are the spear of the Empire, For the Emperor!"
Current Legion Commander: John, who may be replaced by Rose, Eleonor, or Kali depending on the situation.
Rumors say that the Emperor pursed his lips in displeasure because of the name Aphrodite chose.

"Love the history and the symbolism, not the individual, Darling. Although the Spartans served Ares, they were the best of the best when it came to being sent into a desperate situation with a smile on their faces. Leonidas was there to prove it. That was the kind of spirit we need." Aphrodite said. Despite her words being logical, Scathach and Rose suspected that Aphrodite simply wanted to keep something Greek alive in some way. Love it or hate it, your birthplace was still your birthplace, so respect was necessary.

That suspicion became certainty when the Greek goddesses quickly supported Aphrodite, forming a united front. Even the Greek goddess of luck joined Aphrodite, being a goddess who never gets involved in trouble.
The only ones who stayed out were Nyx and Gaia, who do not care about it at all.

Because of this united front, Victor simply pursed his lips and accepted it, although inside he was amused internally. Since it was only a name, he did not care that much. After all, with the passage of time, that name would be associated with him, and not with the Greeks. But at this moment, when the legion was created in honor of the Greeks, it was immortalized in history. And that was what Aphrodite and the Greek goddesses wanted.

Because of the action that the goddesses took, Victor realized that there were very few things referencing the Greeks. Although he dislikes the gods of that pantheon, since they were practically eliminated now in name, he did not mind letting his subordinate goddesses be happy.

Therefore, on that same day that the First Legion was created, a city called Aphrodisias was recreated once again in the heart of the Empire, Yggdrasil, and which would be the headquarters of the First Legion.

Aphrodite also gained that day a super spaceship with more than 300,000 KM2 of internal space capable of housing 50 million beings. Despite the gigantic space, the spaceship was the size of a cruiser capable of destroying a solar system, measuring 60 km by 15 km in length and width. All of this is possible because of the runes that greatly expanded the internal space.
She also gained an entire planet for herself to shape however she wished, where she would rebuild her Greek temple.
The smile of happiness that Aphrodite gave, along with the explosion of her divinity, was strong enough to affect even the dragon gods.
"DARLING, I LOVE YOU!" She hugged him and kissed his entire face, over and over again.

Each new planet had a new Tower of Challenges, a copy of Babylon that was placed to encourage everyone to surpass their limits.
These towers created a large interconnected system.
If an explorer enters the tower of Yggdrasil and another enters the tower of a distant solar system, they will still meet on the same floor.
Each floor was gigantic, capable of reaching the size of the old Earth or the size of a mega-planet.
The floors were expanded and reduced automatically according to the size of the challengers in each of them.
Thanks to the Tower of Challenges, the culture around the Empire grew to become a culture of warriors.
However, unlike ancient societies that valued only warriors, within the Empire everyone knew how to respect one another because each had a role to play for the Emperor.
Another group of beings that were loving this new era were the gods of the other pantheons.
They were not like Victor, who was loyal to his wives.
As long as they felt desire, they spread their seeds everywhere, sleeping with anyone who was interested in them.
And with the superior technology of the Empire and powerful dragon gods...
Bloodline problems were no longer the norm, which means that...
Demigods spread like plagues.
In the 30,000 millennium, harems were something common.
As long as the individual had resources and could support their wives or husbands, everything was allowed.
It was truly a divine era, where gods and mortals walked without conflicts.
More than 30 thousand years of development passed, and during that time, the legions of the Empire began to appear.
The first legions appeared at the beginning of year 20 of the Imperial calendar, specifically two legions.
Created by the goddesses Ariel, Kaguya, Nyx, Leona, and Tasha.
The Sixth Legion: The Silent Judgment.
This legion was responsible for applying Imperial law in any newly acquired territory.
They usually act together with the third legion.
If the third legion was the justice of the shadows, the sixth legion was justice in the light.
Sixth Legion: The Silent Judgment.
Function: Execution, punishment, and cleansing of corrupted or rebellious planets, maintaining order within the Empire at any cost.
Responsible for: judging, applying absolute laws, and eradicating heresies at first sight.
Common units: Elite soldiers, executioners, inquisitors, mind readers, empathic beings capable of feeling emotions, etc.
Internal slogan: "Heresy will not be tolerated."
Current Commander: Jeanne Elderblood, with Leona acting as her substitute when Jeanne is busy.

Just like the sixth legion, the third was created soon after by Nyx, Kaguya, and Persephone; this legion was made to operate in the shadows; the dirty work of the Empire would fall into their hands in ’most cases’.
Third Legion.
The Black Hand of the Emperor.
Or, as it is called, B.H.E.
Function: Intelligence, espionage, infiltration, and psychological warfare, etc.
Responsible for: Hunting traitors, destabilizing enemies, controlling the imperial narrative, etc.
Most common units: Shadow assassins, telepaths, shapeshifters, shadow demons, etc.
Internal slogan: "No one sees what bleeds in the dark."
Current Commander: Kaguya Elderblood, with Nyx acting when Kaguya is busy.
The 3rd and 6th legions act as the police and the secret service of the Empire, but these were not the only legions created.
In the 50th year of the Imperial calendar, Ruby, Velnorah, Natalia, and Alice descended in their avatars and decided to unify all the knowledge of the Empire.
On that day, the fourth legion called Stellar Arsenal was created.
This legion was also responsible for acquiring and studying future alien knowledge.
Fourth Legion: Stellar Arsenal
Function: Research, development, and control of super weapons and forbidden technology.
Responsible for: Creating weapons of mass destruction on the scale of solar systems and beyond, genetic experiments, temporal manipulation, etc.
Most common units: scientists, engineers, witches, and automatons to deal with more dangerous experiments, etc.
Internal slogan: "Progress at any cost."
Current Commander: Ruby Elderblood, with Velnorah or Aline acting as commander when Ruby is not available.
With only these 3 legions, most of the systems of the Empire were organized, but the protection of the Imperial family was still necessary.
Therefore, the Imperial Guard was expanded and became the fifth legion.
Created personally by the Emperor, this legion contained the best of the best.
It was made to protect the Emperor’s family, as well as the fervent faithful of the Empire.
Each sacred temple had at least 3 to 5 units protecting it.
They were often called Sacred Guards by the most fervent faithful.
And even though it seemed there were only a few protecting the sacred temples, they were the best of the best.
Only one of them was enough to deal with most threats.
Five, in most cases, was an exaggeration.
Because of its extremely important function, this was one of the legions that had fewer common units and more elite units.
These elite units could be sent to any legion if support was needed.
Fifth Legion: The Imperial Guard.
Function: Personal defense of the Imperial Family, the faithful, and sacred relics.
Responsible for: Protecting Victor, his wives, daughters, and places considered sacred.
Most common units: Elite warriors handpicked by the Emperor or Empress.
Internal slogan: "We protect the hope of the Empire."
Current Commander: Nero Elderblood, Ophis Elderblood, Rose Elderblood when Nero and Ophis are not present.
In the 1000th year of the Imperial Calendar, two new legions were created, respectively the 1st and the 2nd legion.
First Legion: Spartan Legion.

Backstory: named in honor of the famous Spartans, this legion was created by Aphrodite together with Scathach and Rose, and trained personally by Scathach and Rose to invade, conquer, and secure everything for the Empire.
If a battle happened, this legion would be the first to enter combat.
Function: Direct attack, invasion, and large-scale offense.
Responsible for: Conquering planets, breaking stellar defenses, and leading campaigns against external enemies.
Most common units: war dragons, armored soldiers, siege mages, spaceships capable of exploding planets and solar systems, etc.
Internal slogan: "We are the spear of the Empire, For the Emperor!"
Current Legion Commander: John, who may be replaced by Rose, Eleonor, or Kali depending on the situation.
Rumors say that the Emperor pursed his lips in displeasure because of the name Aphrodite chose.
"Love the history and the symbolism, not the individual, Darling.
Although the Spartans served Ares, they were the best of the best when it came to being sent into a desperate situation with a smile on their faces.
Leonidas was there to prove it.
That was the kind of spirit we need." Aphrodite said.
Despite her words being logical, Scathach and Rose suspected that Aphrodite simply wanted to keep something Greek alive in some way.
Love it or hate it, your birthplace was still your birthplace, so respect was necessary.
That suspicion became certainty when the Greek goddesses quickly supported Aphrodite, forming a united front.
Even the Greek goddess of luck joined Aphrodite, being a goddess who never gets involved in trouble.
The only ones who stayed out were Nyx and Gaia, who do not care about it at all.
Because of this united front, Victor simply pursed his lips and accepted it, although inside he was amused internally.
Since it was only a name, he did not care that much.
After all, with the passage of time, that name would be associated with him, and not with the Greeks.
But at this moment, when the legion was created in honor of the Greeks, it was immortalized in history.
And that was what Aphrodite and the Greek goddesses wanted.
Because of the action that the goddesses took, Victor realized that there were very few things referencing the Greeks.
Although he dislikes the gods of that pantheon, since they were practically eliminated now in name, he did not mind letting his subordinate goddesses be happy.

Therefore, on that same day that the First Legion was created, a city called Aphrodisias was recreated once again in the heart of the Empire, Yggdrasil, and which would be the headquarters of the First Legion.
Aphrodite also gained that day a super spaceship with more than 300,000 KM2 of internal space capable of housing 50 million beings.
Despite the gigantic space, the spaceship was the size of a cruiser capable of destroying a solar system, measuring 60 km by 15 km in length and width.
All of this is possible because of the runes that greatly expanded the internal space.
She also gained an entire planet for herself to shape however she wished, where she would rebuild her Greek temple.
The smile of happiness that Aphrodite gave, along with the explosion of her divinity, was strong enough to affect even the dragon gods.
"DARLING, I LOVE YOU!" She hugged him and kissed his entire face, over and over again.

chapters.title: Chapter 1140: Time to develop. 2
paragraphs: Chapter 1140: Time to develop. 2
"DARLING, I LOVE YOU!" She hugged him and kissed his entire face, over and over again.
Victor sighed and said internally: ’What won’t I do for you?’
"Muah, Muah, Muah."
Seeing how happy she was, Victor simply smiled while hugging her.
It was worth noting that, as a result of this decision, all of his Greek wives became extremely jealous. Even Hestia, who was quiet and usually understanding, was pouting.
Because of that, Victor had to expand the planet enough to make it slightly larger than the old Earth so the Greek goddesses could spread across the world and rebuild their temples.

Gaia and Nyx acted indifferent and stayed out of it, but at the first opportunity, when the planet was ready, they approached him, kissed him, saying: "I love you, Darling. Thank you for everything!" And ran to the planet to make their temples.
"AAHHH! You narcissistic idiots, I do all the work, and you think you can act in front of me!? You primordial goddesses haven’t changed at all!" Aphrodite exploded in anger.
When Aphrodite ran to the planet, Hestia, who was silent, together with Persephone, simply hugged him and kissed his lips gently.
"Thank you for the gift, Darling." Unlike Aphrodite’s excitement, Hestia’s gesture was more gentle and subtle, befitting the goddess of the hearth and family.
"There is no need for thanks between us, my dear."

"Wrong. Thank you is necessary. If everyone forgets basic things like ’thank you’, ’please’, and ’I’m sorry’. People can become spoiled beings who think the world owes them everything."𝐟𝕣𝕖𝐞𝐰𝕖𝚋𝐧𝗼𝚟𝐞𝕝.𝗰𝐨𝐦
"Especially among us siblings, it is good to maintain humility."
Victor gently caressed Hestia’s face and said, "That is why we have you, right? Our goddess of the home and family to take care of everyone and maintain harmony."
"... Exactly." Hestia smiled gently. With one last kiss and hug, Hestia descended to the planet with Persephone, who sneakily ran to Victor, kissed him, and said:
"It’s like she said, Darling. Thank you very much for the planet. My fellow goddesses and I know that the Greeks as a pantheon can no longer exist, but we would like to preserve our culture."
"Greek cultures, huh," Victor said while his eyes shone dangerously for a few seconds.
"... Well, some of them will be extinguished for obvious reasons. We only want to preserve the ’beautiful’ side of our culture."
"Good." Victor laughed. "Now go have fun."
"Mm!" With one last kiss, she ran to the planet.

Victor sighed. Sometimes he thought he didn’t have wives but a bunch of children to take care of. They complain that he was spoiling their daughters, but at the first opportunity, they act just like their daughters. But it was fun to see them acting like that, so he just laughed and let the matter go.
"... Hmm, Darling~... Unlike the Greeks, we have always been allies~." A sun goddess approached sneakily and hugged Victor.
Victor raised an amused eyebrow while looking at his sun goddess and Haruna, who was sneakily nearby.
"You are not satisfied with the city?"
"The city is too small for us to practice our customs..." Amaterasu opened her fan, with her eyes shining slightly. "We can make a Yukata presentation for you, fufufu."
"Yukata, huh..." Victor displayed a smile that made Amaterasu and Haruna blush. Even though they had been married for so long, they had zero resistance to their husband.
"If Amaterasu lets me caress her tails."
"Fufufu, you can caress whatever you want, Darling." She said while using her powers to create fox ears and 10 tails.

"Stealing other people’s characteristics, you bad goddess." Haruna snorted, and soon she returned to her old form and hugged Victor, wrapping him in her tails. "I am the original fox, you are just a fake."
"Ara~, who decided that? With the power to shape reality, I can be a fox if I want too, fufufufu~" Amaterasu approached and hugged him while covering him with her tails.
Surrounded by two ’cunning foxes’ who wrapped him in their fluffy tails, Victor had no choice but to give in and give them a planet.
"You convinced me, I will give you a planet."
How difficult it was to be the Emperor...
"Kya! Thank you, Darling! I love you!" Amaterasu kissed him the same way Aphrodite did before.
Haruna only wrapped him tighter in her embrace.
"I will try to make Kaguya and Mizuki return to their origins and make a presentation for you~," Amaterasu promised.
"That will be interesting to see." Victor could hardly wait.
Victor’s ’difficulties’ aside... Returning to the timeline, the second legion was created after this incident.
Second Legion: Order of the Iron Veil

Backstory: Created personally by Eleonor, Violet, Haruna, and Hela. This legion serves as the defender of imperial territories and can, if necessary, act as an attack legion alongside the first legion. After all, some say the best defense is to have the best offense.
Function: Planetary defense and protection of imperial territories.
Responsible for: Planetary shields, fortified zones, bastions, and defense rings, etc.
Most common units: Stationary knights, climate controllers, orbital towers, etc.
Internal slogan: "We protect the Empire until the last breath."
Current legion commander: Eleonor Elderblood, who may be replaced by Haruna or Hela depending on the situation.

Of these 6 legions, only two receive solar-system destruction class weaponry, with them being the 1st and the 2nd legion. The others, if necessary, can also use these weapons, but only with the permission of the Supreme General, Scathach, and the Emperor himself.

Effectively, the first and second legions acted as the military of the old world, which was why they were the most numerous. One acted as the spear of the Empire, and the other acted as the shield of the Empire. Often, they acted together to deal with threats.

All legions answered directly to Scathach and to the Emperor himself if he gave the order. To avoid chaos when executing orders, everyone, regardless of legion, must obey Scathach if she orders something. If she does not order anyone directly, the legion command remains with the selected commanders of those legions.

Effectively, Scathach Elderblood holds the title of goddess of war and Supreme General of the Empire’s forces. A promotion that Scathach herself liked very much, however, because of that, she was very busy, considering her standards were extremely high.
One funny thing was that even having several beings in her hands to shape, she never found another being with the same monstrous talent as her disciple and now husband, Victor.
Perhaps the only ones who came close in talent and potential were their daughters, which was ridiculous if you think about it.
But these were not all the forces of the Empire. These forces were only those that the public knew existed.

The leviathans that Victor created were not counted, nor were the dragons hidden in Victor’s world, nor were several forces of hell, such as the ancient demons who served as guards and acted more like scholars. They were incredibly strong, especially now that Victor helped them evolve and become something like a Primordial Demon.

The Valkyries of Rose and Eleonor, who had now expanded, were also not counted. The personal forces of the Emperor himself, such as the cosmic horrors that he could unleash at any moment, were also not counted.
They were not the only ones. There were still many hidden forces that only Victor himself and Violet knew existed.
By Victor’s own command, Violet was creating these forces and keeping them as a trump card. Many times she asked for help from sisters like Ruby, while other times she did it alone.
The more cards Victor had in his hand, the more options he would have in the future. And this was the best moment to increase his options even more.
That same year, hidden from everyone, a seventh legion was created, which was called:
Children of the Abyss.

Backstory: Created personally by the Emperor himself, along with Empress Violet. They exist on paper, but nothing is known about them. Just know that if you see the Eye on a uniform... Do not look at their face, or you will go insane.
Function: Defense against extradimensional threats, cosmic entities, and primordial horrors.
Responsible for: Maintaining the boundaries and structure of reality intact, fighting invaders from other dimensions and the unknown itself.
Common units: Classified.
Internal slogan: "What comes from beyond... meets its end here."

Current commander: Classified. But the appearance was described: He wore a hooded armor, his wings seemed to absorb the very light of existence. He was the Emperor’s Herald. When this force was sent, only existential erasure awaited.

This legion could only be commanded by the Emperor himself. If the Emperor cannot command them, the Empress, the goddess of Order, Violet, would assume command... If neither of them were available, Azathoth would assume command.

Only these three could command this legion. Anyone else would go insane if they spent too much time with them, because this legion was created using Victor’s Eldritch powers to the extreme. Even if his wives had resistance, it was not as high as Violet, who had a high resistance from being a goddess of order, and Azathoth and Victor themselves, who were like the God Kings of this mad pantheon.
Perhaps in the future, Hela would have the capacity to command this legion, too, but for now, only Violet was qualified.

In the 30,000th year of the imperial calendar, all 6 legions were filled with beings. Just one legion could contain billions of forces, with the smallest being the fifth legion, while the Imperial Guard numbered in the millions, not billions.
But even with so many beings, the command structure remained completely efficient. All this merit went to the Emperor’s daughter, Akasha Elderblood, and to her operators, handcrafted by Victor.

Even though they did not form a legion in name, Akasha and her operators, who helped the legions, were a force of the Empire, and those who entered this squadron were only those created directly by the Emperor.

Their location was strictly confidential. No one except the Emperor’s family knew their location. As the eyes and ears of the Empire, they always stayed in the most protected place in the Empire, meaning they were always stationed within Victor’s own world, where his family stayed.

Even being practically in another dimension, they could still act from anywhere, and effects such as dimensional blocks were useless to them since they were intimately connected with every part of the Empire.

Since they were among the most important parts of the command structure, several tests, ranging from dimensional blocking to complete closure of space, were performed, expanding the system and ensuring nothing could block them.
The reason for this was simple: they live within the Emperor himself and use his senses and power to communicate with everyone.
Unless Victor himself was sealed, it was impossible for them to go offline. And even in that minimal chance of that happening, Victor prepared countermeasures.
After all, he was paranoid like that. And being one of the most important parts of the Empire, they deserved such precaution.

Akasha’s squad operated like a vast network of countless smaller artificial intelligences. It was an entire ecosystem with Akasha at the top, followed by her subordinates, then by quintillions of artificial intelligences acting as shields that change every second and create more every second. The structure was made that way on purpose in case of a possible invasion: they can cut their losses and delete the artificial intelligence immediately.
This measure was put in place to address potential technology gods like Velnorah. Having a mother like that, Akasha knows very well the level of threat she can be if she were on the other side.
Therefore, she created a system that even her mother cannot violate without a lot of effort. One that would only improve over time.
As her father liked to say, it was always good to have more options, and Akasha would not rest until she had at least the capacity to completely block her mother outside of her system.

Although all of this was a huge exaggeration. For them to be affected in the first place, any attack must pass through the supreme defense, which was Victor himself. After all, they lived inside Victor.
Few beings can look into the eyes of a cosmic horror and leave with their sanity intact. But even understanding this, Akasha would not be satisfied. She inherited her father’s paranoia after all.
30,000 years had passed, but the 200,000-year deadline had not yet been reached. They still had a lot of work to do. The population had not even reached 500 trillion beings yet.

Even being practically in another dimension, they could still act from anywhere, and effects such as dimensional blocks were useless to them since they were intimately connected with every part of the Empire.

Since they were among the most important parts of the command structure, several tests, ranging from dimensional blocking to complete closure of space, were performed, expanding the system and ensuring nothing could block them.
The reason for this was simple: they live within the Emperor himself and use his senses and power to communicate with everyone.
Unless Victor himself was sealed, it was impossible for them to go offline.
And even in that minimal chance of that happening, Victor prepared countermeasures.
After all, he was paranoid like that.
And being one of the most important parts of the Empire, they deserved such precaution.
Akasha’s squad operated like a vast network of countless smaller artificial intelligences.

It was an entire ecosystem with Akasha at the top, followed by her subordinates, then by quintillions of artificial intelligences acting as shields that change every second and create more every second.
The structure was made that way on purpose in case of a possible invasion: they can cut their losses and delete the artificial intelligence immediately.
This measure was put in place to address potential technology gods like Velnorah.
Having a mother like that, Akasha knows very well the level of threat she can be if she were on the other side.
Therefore, she created a system that even her mother cannot violate without a lot of effort.
One that would only improve over time.
As her father liked to say, it was always good to have more options, and Akasha would not rest until she had at least the capacity to completely block her mother outside of her system.
Although all of this was a huge exaggeration.
For them to be affected in the first place, any attack must pass through the supreme defense, which was Victor himself.
After all, they lived inside Victor.
Few beings can look into the eyes of a cosmic horror and leave with their sanity intact.
But even understanding this, Akasha would not be satisfied.
She inherited her father’s paranoia after all.
30,000 years had passed, but the 200,000-year deadline had not yet been reached.
They still had a lot of work to do.
The population had not even reached 500 trillion beings yet.

chapters.title: Chapter 1141: Goddess of Time, Natalia.
paragraphs: Chapter 1141: Goddess of Time, Natalia.

Time distorted as she arrived, a five meter tall woman with long golden hair looked down at the planet below her. Calling that rock a planet was an offense to the planets themselves. This world was merely a floating rock that had just come together.
Her name was Natalia Elderblood, the Dragon Goddess of Time, one of the wives of Emperor Victor Elderblood.
"Let’s speed things up a little," Natalia said.
[I will support you.] She heard Victor’s voice.
[Mm.] She nodded with a small smile on her face, closing her eyes for a few moments.

When she opened her eyes, they became like the cosmoses themselves. Her wings opened, and with a flap of her wings, all time acted abnormally. Everything remained still until, like a fast-forward button, the planet below her appeared to spin at high speed.
Billions of years passed like that, turning the rock into a full-fledged planet. Soon she began to shrink until time returned to normal.

Normally, she did not need to concentrate so much to do such a simple job, but since she was using her energies and authority over time to keep the ritual functioning on a galactic scale, she needed more effort so as not to compromise the ritual itself.
"... As expected, this is the most efficient way." Said Natalia when she saw a seed of the world tree beginning to appear on the rock that is now a planet.
Victor’s image appeared beside her: "Even with our terraforming technology, planets do not become habitable like in the movies."
"Therefore, it is as we expected, right?"

"Yes. The Primordial Chaos that created everything made it so that all of its creation was in the hands of the primordials. The fact that we cannot transform a floating rock into a habitable planet even with all our power and technology has only one explanation... this is one of the fundamental rules of existence."
Even with all of Victor’s power, he cannot ignore the fundamental rules of the universe... Well, that was not exactly true. Victor felt that if he tried a little, he could break that rule.
’If I use Eldritch powers, I can transform this planet into something habitable, but... This action will completely distort the planet.’ The powers of the outer gods are essentially contradictory.

If an Eldritch God creates life, that life will not be something normal like everyone knows, but something distorted from what ’life should be’. Yes, the principle of Azathoth’s pantheon was chaos. Nothing functioned as it should because the concept of order did not exist, and even if he added the concept of order to his creations, the essence of an Outer God would contaminate the order and turn it into something abominable.
Because of this nature, the Eldritch pantheon of Azathoth was extremely powerful, but fundamentally couldn’t function without their ’distorted logic’.
"So we should do what we are doing here, go to each solar system and accelerate the time of some giant rock?" Natalia said.

With their experience, they discovered that in each solar system, there likely existed a seed of a world tree that would awaken when the planet reached a critical point. Because of that, Natalia was jumping between solar systems that lacked a planet with a world tree to accelerate time, and so far, the success rate was quite high. Every 10 solar systems, 4 had a planet that had a world tree seed. Of the 200 solar systems she visited, these statistics remained consistent.

"No." Victor denied. With his divine perspective, he could see that space was not lacking for his population, so there was no need to intervene too much in this matter. As an interplanetary civilization that could alter the cosmos as it wished, what it lacked the least was space.

"Let nature follow its course, our experiment ends here." Victor, as a god of <BEGIN>, understood that the beginning was always precious, not to mention that Roxanne would complain if he brought more world trees for her to take care of.

He looked at the seed of the world tree on that planet and, with a gentle touch, placed it in his world. All the experiments he did among the planets, Victor did not leave those world trees alone. After all, he altered their destiny, so it was his duty to take care of them.

Controlling reality, Victor took the entire planet and placed it in the territory of his Empire. He became increasingly proficient in this technique, it was as if he were playing a galactic-scale RTS game, and he was a super powerful god who could at any moment move entire planets or an entire solar system. These actions made his inner child have fun.
"Let’s go back." He raised his hand and extended it to Natalia.
Natalia smiled lovingly and held his hand: "Yes."
"The next phase will begin?" Ruby asked Aline.

"Yes... We planned that the development from the 30,000th to the 50,000th millennium of the imperial calendar will be about genetics. We will raise the existential level of everyone." Aline said while looking at the data in front of her.
"What will be the life expectancy of the population?" Ruby asked.
"It will not be different... Probably between 200 to 300 years." Aline answered.
"Hmm... Is that good? Or bad?"
"With the scale that the Empire has become, even if everyone lived all 300 years of their lives, they would not be able to explore all our territory, so diseases like divine boredom will not happen."

Divine boredom was not the official name, but it was an appropriate name for that feeling. Fortunately, with the scale of the Empire now that it practically exists across the entire Milky Way, the citizens of the Empire will never become bored.

"... That is ridiculous if you think about it calmly." Ruby could not help but say. If her younger self, that lazy vampire who was studying in college, heard the scale of things as they are today, she would probably call her future self a delusional madwoman.
The Empire spanned the entire Milky Way, and unlike the Milky Way before, Victor turned it into a supergalaxy, with at least two neighboring galaxies merged into it.𝙛𝓻𝒆𝒆𝒘𝙚𝓫𝙣𝙤𝒗𝙚𝓵.𝙘𝙤𝙢

"Instead of worrying about that, we should worry about the integration of future generations. With the Empire being gigantic, the feeling of unity must be the main priority." Velnorah said while entering the laboratory. Her long, blue hair was tied in a ponytail that reached her butt.
"That is indeed a necessary concern..." Ruby commented.

The fact that the Empire was ridiculously large did not help implement necessary policies. Fortunately, most of the current beings are individuals who have already died at some point in life and reincarnated as members of the Empire, so the sense of loyalty was 100%.

But as her husband always said: ’It is never good to leave gaps for enemies to exploit’. Therefore, education and indoctrination were important, as practically all teaching material spoke about the Emperor and his Empress goddesses.
"We should-..." When Ruby was about to explain her idea, but stopped when she heard Victor’s words.

[From now on, I will no longer merge galaxies. We must reinforce our central structures. A territory that is too large is also difficult to defend if necessary.] He sent a mental message to all the wives, and soon he stopped speaking, returning to silence.
"... Darling is tired," Ruby commented after feeling Victor’s state. Since they were all wives who had made a soul marriage, they knew how the others were, even if they were not close.

"Indeed. The energy expenditure is becoming even higher the longer the time passes within the ritual." Velnorah narrowed her eyes, a worried look appearing on her face. Even knowing that her sisters were always by his side, she would still worry. After all, he was her husband.
"The prediction is that when the 160,000th year of the Imperial calendar arrives, he will be replenishing energy at the same rate he is spending it."

Victor was practicing holding the weight of all reality on his shoulders. All actions within the ritual spend energy from his side. Even with his immense reserves, there would come a moment when he would not be able to withstand the weight of everything, even with his wives helping, and Jeanne as well.
The greatest weight was still on his shoulders.
"... All this because Darling does not let me help him." A woman in a black dress appeared. She was present and at the same time not, only existing as an image.
"You know you cannot, Azathoth," Ruby said with a solemn look. She understood Azathoth’s feelings very well.

"Yes, my essence would distort everything." She said with a growl. She was extremely frustrated for not being able to help with anything. All her sisters were helping, but she could not do anything! She even tried to help Victor by giving him energy, but he refused. After all, Eldritch energy cannot be involved in the ritual, or everything could literally implode from the inside.
Aline began to break out in cold sweat when she saw reality distort under Azathoth’s anger.
"... Just stay by his side, sister. Sometimes, just your presence will help his burden." Velnorah said gently while ignoring what Azathoth’s presence was doing in the laboratory.
"..." Azathoth looked at Velnorah for a few seconds and nodded obediently. "You are right... I should go back." Her image began to disappear.
"Aline, you do not need to be afraid, she is our sister," Velnorah said while using the powers of altering reality to fix the damage that Azathoth’s presence caused.

"It is not fear... It is just that I cannot help but feel that her presence is wrong." After so long with Azathoth, Aline no longer feared her sister, but when she lost control of her temper, she could not help but feel that something was wrong.

Logically, she understood, but she could not contain her basic instincts. Azathoth did not get offended by this, since she knew that if it were not for Victor’s influence, none of the current women would be capable of looking at her face without going insane.

Ruby and Velnorah remained silent. Despite being more resistant than ordinary beings thanks to the connection they had with Victor and the several times he bathed them in his essence, they were still not on the same level as Azathoth or Azathoth’s daughter with Victor, Yog-Sothoth.
But they were better than beings with no resistance at all. If a normal mortal looked at Azathoth, they would simply implode from not understanding what they were seeing.
"Our sister became stronger," Ruby commented after evaluating the state of the outer goddess.
Velnorah and Aline nodded. Unlike before, Azathoth seemed much more present. She was not truly here, still contained in her seal, but it was evident that she was becoming stronger.
"Influence of Darling?" Aline deduced.
"Probably... Or the seal is weakening, which is very unlikely," Velnorah replied.
"In any case, it is a good thing that she is becoming stronger. That way, things may end more peacefully in the future." Ruby said casually.
"That is true." Velnorah and Aline said at the same time.
Soon they returned to work. Specifically, they returned to discussing the mental message that Victor gave to everyone.

chapters.title: Chapter 1142: Scathach’s Competitiveness.
paragraphs: Chapter 1142: Scathach’s Competitiveness.

Scathach was sitting at the top of a black stone platform, observing the artificial horizon stretching out before her. The area was silent, except for the distant sound of millions of footsteps echoing in disorganized rhythms. This entire place had been recently built, a colossal extension of training fields, arenas, fortresses, and logistical structures that seemed to stretch into infinity.
An entire planet was dedicated exclusively to training new soldiers.
She rested her chin on the back of her hand, staring expressionlessly at the vastness.
"One hundred million this time, huh," Scathach murmured.
The number sounded strange, even to her.

Scathach had trained armies before. Entire tribes. Orders of warriors. Complete legions. So this number was nothing new, and while she was thinking about the past, she would have never imagined having so many people under her command.
She raised her hand, and a projection appeared in the air before her.
Lines of data. Divisions. Classifications. Different races. Different species. Some were vampires, most were hybrids of other races, with humans being the largest group.
There were also demons, spiritual beings, and some new and ancient races that didn’t even exist a few centuries ago.
Victor’s Empire had this annoying tendency to create new things, although it wasn’t really his fault. As it was the Empire’s plan to create as many new beings as possible.
She scanned the data with her eyes.
"Interesting." The number of humans with mixed ancestry from other races was higher than the ’pure’ races themselves, and in no way were they weaker than ’pure’ vampires, she laughed in disdain.
In the past, such creatures would be seen as abominations by supernatural beings, but for Victor’s Empire, all of this was normal.
After all, any genetic problem of a race could be solved by the Empire’s technology.
Therefore, the tradition of some more radical groups ended up returning so that the choice of a partner was based on how much potential they had, rather than what their race was.
’Somehow, everything ends up going back to the past, huh.’ She laughed when she thought about it, considering that the tribe she came from had that same mentality.
A voice appeared behind her.
"You seem worried."
Scathach didn’t need to look to know who it was.
"Worried is not the word, Siena."
Siena walked up to her, crossing her arms as she observed the training field below.
From where they were, it was possible to see tens of millions of soldiers spread across the artificial plains.
Some were fighting.
Others were training formations.
Some were simply trying to survive.
Siena whistled.
"That’s a lot of people... And this is just the beginning." Scathach replied calmly.
By the end of the day, this number was expected to practically become 1 billion.
"Yes."
She turned her attention back to the data.

"Training one hundred million individuals is not the problem." As a dragon goddess, she could bend reality to be in multiple places at the same time, but that was counterproductive, since not everyone deserved her attention.

That didn’t mean they wouldn’t receive the best training, of course. It just meant the goddess could focus her efforts on others, as she had always enjoyed polishing talent into a beautiful gem of power.
Siena raised an amused eyebrow.
"No?"
Scathach shook her head. "The problem is quality."
She expanded the map as the projection now showed thousands of sectors.
"If I train them all together..." She paused for a moment. "...the result will be mediocre."
Siena tilted her head.
"Why?"
Scathach explained as if it were obvious.
"Biological differences."
"Oh..." Siena immediately understood what she meant, but she didn’t interrupt her mother.
Scathach began pointing at different groups.
"These vampires have absurd regeneration."
"These hybrids have combat instincts."
"These demons rely on infernal energy."
She changed the projection again.
"But these ones..." She pointed to a specific group.
"...are basically new."
Siena looked more closely.
"Converted civilians?"
"Yes."
Siena nodded in confirmation. "So half of them don’t know how to fight."
Scathach corrected her.
"More than half... Most of them haven’t even set foot in the tower to prove themselves."

Siena remained silent for a few seconds, understanding why there was such inconsistency compared to the past. The answer was the aggressive expansion her husband had carried out, as most of the beings here were babies who hadn’t even picked up a weapon yet. A very high percentage of people were holding a weapon for the first time today.
"So what’s the plan?" Siena asked.
Scathach closed her eyes for a moment, using her divine mind for the best possible strategy.
When she opened her eyes again, several new projections appeared around them.
"First, they will be divided, the instructors will baptize the newcomers, those with potential will be separated from the rest and sent to the correct divisions."
"Second, those with combat experience will be sent on various expeditions to be evaluated."
Scathach began issuing orders to Siena and her assistants through the Empire’s technology.
This planet had the best of the best teachers to mold a perfect soldier, even a normal human would leave here as a superhuman. Even if he died somehow, the goddess could simply bring him back.

In a way, this planet managed by Scathach was like a rite of passage into adulthood for everyone in the Empire. Everyone who reached the physical and mental maturity of their species was required to come here to undergo training.
"And finally... Those who are exceptional will be trained directly by me."
"Mother, you have to lower your evaluation criteria a lot."
"I know."
"Mother, you have to lower it even more." Siena sighed when she looked at Scathach’s evaluation criteria.
She was basically looking for a very nerfed version of her own daughters, but that was ridiculous and very unlikely to happen.
After all, not everyone had the Emperor’s genes. A nerfed version of her own daughters had the potential to surpass even a low-level imperial guard that had not been modified by the Emperor.

And those beings had the capability to face entire low-level pantheons if necessary, and that was even before their ascension through the Emperor’s hands. After all, Victor did not joke around when it came to the family’s safety.

Comparing the Emperor’s family to everyone else was simply absolutely unfair. Even if Victor’s daughters did nothing, they would still become extremely strong, and with the rigorous training of Scathach and Victor? They were basically an absolute unit of power.
"... Hmm, I thought that with this new batch, I could increase the criteria even more, but it seems not, huh."
"We have to wait for the next development of the Stellar Arsenal. They will greatly improve everyone’s genes by the 100,000th year of the Imperial calendar."
"... Fine." She pouted, it seems like she wouldn’t have much fun with this batch.
As the supreme commander of all legions, they all answered to her, but, ironically, during times of development, she was the one with the most free time since none of her sisters were incompetent.

In the end, she was left in charge of monitoring the new recruits. Occasionally, she would find a rare gem that she would personally train, then that rare gem would be introduced into the imperial guard or the Spartan legions.

Scathach laughed when she thought about that legion. At first, Aphrodite was excited to have an entire planet for herself, but she was practically buried in work. After all, who would have thought that dealing with billions of beings, organizing everything, and making it perfect would be easy?
Fortunately, she was a dragon and wouldn’t become exhausted because of something like that, and frequently, she and Rose helped Aphrodite so she could rest her mind a bit.
"Where are my daughters?"
"Lacus is dealing with the new recruits, and Pepper is in Yggdrasil promoting a new game."
"... Does she need to do that personally?"

Scathach was sitting at the top of a black stone platform, observing the artificial horizon stretching out before her.
The area was silent, except for the distant sound of millions of footsteps echoing in disorganized rhythms.
This entire place had been recently built, a colossal extension of training fields, arenas, fortresses, and logistical structures that seemed to stretch into infinity.
An entire planet was dedicated exclusively to training new soldiers.
She rested her chin on the back of her hand, staring expressionlessly at the vastness.
"One hundred million this time, huh," Scathach murmured.
The number sounded strange, even to her.
Scathach had trained armies before.
Entire tribes.
Orders of warriors.
Complete legions.
So this number was nothing new, and while she was thinking about the past, she would have never imagined having so many people under her command.
She raised her hand, and a projection appeared in the air before her.
Lines of data.
Divisions.
Classifications.
Different races.
Different species.
Some were vampires, most were hybrids of other races, with humans being the largest group.
There were also demons, spiritual beings, and some new and ancient races that didn’t even exist a few centuries ago.
Victor’s Empire had this annoying tendency to create new things, although it wasn’t really his fault.
As it was the Empire’s plan to create as many new beings as possible.
She scanned the data with her eyes.
"Interesting." The number of humans with mixed ancestry from other races was higher than the ’pure’ races themselves, and in no way were they weaker than ’pure’ vampires, she laughed in disdain.
In the past, such creatures would be seen as abominations by supernatural beings, but for Victor’s Empire, all of this was normal.
After all, any genetic problem of a race could be solved by the Empire’s technology.
Therefore, the tradition of some more radical groups ended up returning so that the choice of a partner was based on how much potential they had, rather than what their race was.
’Somehow, everything ends up going back to the past, huh.’ She laughed when she thought about it, considering that the tribe she came from had that same mentality.
A voice appeared behind her.
"You seem worried."
Scathach didn’t need to look to know who it was.
"Worried is not the word, Siena."
Siena walked up to her, crossing her arms as she observed the training field below.
From where they were, it was possible to see tens of millions of soldiers spread across the artificial plains.
Some were fighting.
Others were training formations.
Some were simply trying to survive.
Siena whistled.
"That’s a lot of people...
And this is just the beginning." Scathach replied calmly.
By the end of the day, this number was expected to practically become 1 billion.
"Yes."
She turned her attention back to the data.

"Training one hundred million individuals is not the problem." As a dragon goddess, she could bend reality to be in multiple places at the same time, but that was counterproductive, since not everyone deserved her attention.
That didn’t mean they wouldn’t receive the best training, of course.
It just meant the goddess could focus her efforts on others, as she had always enjoyed polishing talent into a beautiful gem of power.
Siena raised an amused eyebrow.
"No?"
Scathach shook her head.
"The problem is quality."
She expanded the map as the projection now showed thousands of sectors.
"If I train them all together..." She paused for a moment.
"...the result will be mediocre."
Siena tilted her head.
"Why?"
Scathach explained as if it were obvious.
"Biological differences."
"Oh..." Siena immediately understood what she meant, but she didn’t interrupt her mother.
Scathach began pointing at different groups.
"These vampires have absurd regeneration."
"These hybrids have combat instincts."
"These demons rely on infernal energy."
She changed the projection again.
"But these ones..." She pointed to a specific group.
"...are basically new."
Siena looked more closely.
"Converted civilians?"
"Yes."
Siena nodded in confirmation.
"So half of them don’t know how to fight."
Scathach corrected her.
"More than half...
Most of them haven’t even set foot in the tower to prove themselves."
Siena remained silent for a few seconds, understanding why there was such inconsistency compared to the past.
The answer was the aggressive expansion her husband had carried out, as most of the beings here were babies who hadn’t even picked up a weapon yet.
A very high percentage of people were holding a weapon for the first time today.
"So what’s the plan?" Siena asked.
Scathach closed her eyes for a moment, using her divine mind for the best possible strategy.
When she opened her eyes again, several new projections appeared around them.
"First, they will be divided, the instructors will baptize the newcomers, those with potential will be separated from the rest and sent to the correct divisions."
"Second, those with combat experience will be sent on various expeditions to be evaluated."
Scathach began issuing orders to Siena and her assistants through the Empire’s technology.
This planet had the best of the best teachers to mold a perfect soldier, even a normal human would leave here as a superhuman.
Even if he died somehow, the goddess could simply bring him back.
In a way, this planet managed by Scathach was like a rite of passage into adulthood for everyone in the Empire.
Everyone who reached the physical and mental maturity of their species was required to come here to undergo training.
"And finally...
Those who are exceptional will be trained directly by me."
"Mother, you have to lower your evaluation criteria a lot."
"I know."
"Mother, you have to lower it even more." Siena sighed when she looked at Scathach’s evaluation criteria.
She was basically looking for a very nerfed version of her own daughters, but that was ridiculous and very unlikely to happen.
After all, not everyone had the Emperor’s genes.
A nerfed version of her own daughters had the potential to surpass even a low-level imperial guard that had not been modified by the Emperor.
And those beings had the capability to face entire low-level pantheons if necessary, and that was even before their ascension through the Emperor’s hands.
After all, Victor did not joke around when it came to the family’s safety.
Comparing the Emperor’s family to everyone else was simply absolutely unfair.
Even if Victor’s daughters did nothing, they would still become extremely strong, and with the rigorous training of Scathach and Victor?
They were basically an absolute unit of power.
Hmm, I thought that with this new batch, I could increase the criteria even more, but it seems not, huh."

Scathach laughed when she thought about that legion.

Fortunately, she was a dragon and wouldn’t become exhausted because of something like that, and frequently, she and Rose helped Aphrodite so she could rest her mind a bit.
