paragraphs: Chapter 1143: Problematic Blondes.
On the other side of the galaxy, a group of blondes with golden horns had gathered.
"What do you think?" Carmila asked her daughters and her granddaughter.
"I agree," Naty said.
"Me too," Natasha said.
"It’s not that efficient, but... With the number of extraordinary beings, I think he doesn’t need to micromanage everything." Victoria said.
"I still haven’t come to terms with him sending me here. I don’t want to leave his side." Sasha grumbled.
"Fufufu~, isn’t it nice to have all the Fulger women together again?"
"We’re already together every day in the same husband’s bed, Grandma." Sasha showed a cunning smile.
Carmila narrowed her eyes: "...Dear, look at me, do I look like a granny? Stop calling me that, call me sister!"
Sasha rolled her eyes. "Please, all of you are old enough to be relics of the past." She said with a dismissive hand gesture.
"You just shot me even though I didn’t say anything... As expected of my daughter." Natasha laughed proudly.
"Hmm~, is your draconic brain failing, my daughter? Or did you forget your current age? You’re already a relic of the past like us, fufufu~" Naty said.
"...Well..." Sasha couldn’t deny it. In fact, she didn’t even know how old she was anymore, considering things tend to get confusing with Natalia and Victor’s time manipulation.
Even though their main bodies weren’t inside the ritual, and it was just a divine projection, they still spent many years inside their own world doing intimate things with Victor.

Not to mention that when they went to have fun, Victor stretched time until they were satisfied, so that, with a simple calculation including the ritual and those activities, she was over 37 thousand years old.
’Wow, I’m seriously old!’ Sasha smiled tensely.

The amazing part was that Sasha felt like not that much time had passed. She still felt like the same woman who met Victor in that city... Even though she already had a daughter with him and her life had changed drastically compared to before.
’I see... This is Victor’s subtle protection, huh?’ Sasha smiled lovingly when she understood why she didn’t feel like so much time had passed, even though logically that wasn’t the case.
This was just Victor taking care of their mental health. "That’s why Pepper is so lazy and never changes... Although I suspect Victor prefers her that way, as she always was."

The way Victor’s possessiveness manifested varied a lot, but all the wives had already identified it long ago. One of them was this way of protecting their minds so they wouldn’t get bored with everything. Another way was always taking care of their bodies and nourishing them with energy, even if it was no longer necessary. After all, they are already dragon goddesses, but he still does it.
And the wives don’t complain, and in fact, still like it a lot, since they feel like they’re being cared for.
’Kyaaa, Darling, I love you!!!’ She hugged herself and started murmuring something softly.
"...That girl just ignored us and went into her own world." Carmila shook her head, not even questioning why. She had an idea of what her granddaughter was thinking.
"...Speaking of grandchildren... How is that boy?" Carmila looked at Victoria.
"Wow, that was very random." Natasha snorted.
Carmila completely ignored her daughter and kept looking at Victoria.
"Tatsuya? He created a harem, and he’s doing very well." Victoria said in a neutral tone while checking some floating data in front of her.
"...That girl allowed it?" Naty asked as she sat on the couch and grabbed a glass of wine.
"I thought she was the possessive type," Natasha said while drinking wine with her twin.

"Well, it’s not a big harem, it’s just four more women... After that, he couldn’t handle it anymore. The last time I talked to him, he was complaining and asking how Victor managed to deal with so many problematic women."
Victoria narrowed her eyes a little when she remembered what her son said, she is not a problematic woman!

Victoria sighed: "...That boy has always been more interested in himself. If it weren’t for my daughter-in-law throwing herself at him, he wouldn’t move. At least, I’m grateful for that, so he won’t be alone and will always have someone who loves him, even if he finds it troublesome."
"A dense protagonist, huh?" Natasha said.

"It’s more like a Shounen Protagonist who only cares about his adventure," Naty said. "I wouldn’t be surprised if, when he sees how big the Empire has become, he declares he’s going to become the King of space explorers."
The group of wives was much more ’cultured’ now due to Pepper and Ruby’s efforts in spreading culture.

"He’s not that stupid... He’s too serious for that... Probably, he’ll just want to fight all opponents..." At each pause, Victoria thought of possible scenarios where Tatsuya might deviate and do exactly what those implications suggested. Her son could be foolish sometimes.
"Did he get the girl pregnant?"
"Yes."

"Then he can do whatever he wants." Carmila nodded, satisfied. All the women of the Fulger lineage were taken by Victor, therefore, that lineage could no longer develop as before, at least not in name, so it was up to Tatsuya to expand the lineage in the near future.
"You still think like that, you know Darling doesn’t care about names, right?" Natasha rolled her eyes. A good example of that was her own name, which now included Fulger and Elderblood.
"That’s true, but my surname is only on paper, and it doesn’t have that much influence."

The naming of the wives was left to the wives themselves when Victor decided to change his surname. His only requirement was that his surname came first, so most wives followed a similar style; for example, Carmila’s name was Carmila Elderblood Fulger.
At least on paper, but when introducing herself or in divine temple records, her name was simply written as: Carmila Elderblood.

The reason for this was because of their identities as goddesses and wives of the Emperor, it’s easier to organize everything that way. The entire population knows that beings with the name Elderblood are related to the Emperor himself, since that surname is unique in the Empire; only the royal family uses it.
Because of that, the name ’Fulger’ didn’t have as much influence as the Emperor’s surname.

"Why do you care? As long as we consider ourselves Fulger, that name will never die... Just like my old surname." Victoria said. "And speaking coldly, in terms of influence, Elderblood is much more valuable than Fulger. Not that I care, I love Darling, and having his surname is enough, it’s just you who overthinks these things."
"...Ugh, it’s just a distant attachment, okay? You’re all so annoying!" Carmila grumbled.
"It still amazes me that our strict mother became someone so childish," Naty said in disdain.
"Childish? Wrong, I just freed myself when I died, fufufufufu~."
"You didn’t die." Sasha pointed out.
"I died and stayed inside my daughter, along with her distorted personality."
Naty frowned at the metaphorical slap her mother gave her.
Sasha rolled her eyes and decided to take control before a fight broke out. "Alright! Let’s do the job Darling gave us and go back to his side!" She slammed the table as she stood up.
"Yes." Victoria agreed.
"That’s a good idea." Naty nodded.
"...I miss my daughter," Carmila said as she followed Sasha.
"Which one?" Natasha asked cunningly.

"You’re very funny, my daughter." Carmila rolled her eyes. "In our family tree, more complicated than any divine pantheon, there are only mothers and daughters. All women connected to Victor are wives and mothers, and the children we have with him are our daughters."
"Until our daughter becomes a wife too~," Natasha said cunningly.
"..." Sasha raised her hand to argue, but in the end lowered it. It wasn’t like that detail was anything new, considering how many sisters expected that to happen in the near future.
"It’s not like that hasn’t happened before, fufufufu." Naty laughed along with Natasha.
"Metis, Nero, and Ophis are special cases." Victoria pointed out.
"Semantics." Naty and Natasha snorted.
"It’s all Darling’s fault for spoiling them too much!" Sasha huffed.

"It’s not like I would let my daughters suffer with useless men when someone exceptional already exists, and considering Darling’s possessiveness, a suitable man for our daughters might never appear," Naty said while Natasha nodded beside her.
The two women were literally made from the same mold, except for a few topics on which they disagreed, they were practically twins!
"At this rate, our divine pantheon will have an even more complicated family relationship than the Greeks," Sasha said.
"Dear, are you living in an illusion? Our family relationship is already more complicated than the Greeks." Natasha laughed. "Wake up to reality."
"Ugh." Sasha couldn’t deny that.
"At this rate, Darling will be called the Father of All in the future, considering all his descendants will be his children," Victoria said.
"...That’s possible. I’m glad Darling stopped collecting more sisters." Sasha sighed.
"I think the last batch was Ariel, Hela, Dun Scaith, Albedo, and Kali, right?" Carmila said.
"Uh-huh, since that batch, he told Violet to stop looking for wives for him," Sasha said.
"...." This was new information, not even they knew that!
"When did he say that? And how do you know?" Natasha asked.
"Violet told me, and he said it when he spent the last night alone with Violet," Sasha replied.
"That’s... Unexpected, I thought he would be like Solomon." Carmila said.
"Darling isn’t like Solomon, remember, women fell on him like he was an irresistible sweet." Sasha raised her eyebrow imperiously at the family behind her.
She arrived first along with Violet and Ruby, and before she realized it, her entire family’s female lineage became her sisters! That’s absurd!
"...Well, he is an irresistible sweet." Natasha licked her lips when she remembered several things not suitable for minors that she and her husband had done together.
"Indeed," Naty said with a similar expression.
"..." Sasha rolled her eyes at these women.

"...Ugh, it’s just a distant attachment, okay?
You’re all so annoying!" Carmila grumbled.
"It still amazes me that our strict mother became someone so childish," Naty said in disdain.
"Childish?
Wrong, I just freed myself when I died, fufufufufu~."
"You didn’t die." Sasha pointed out.
"I died and stayed inside my daughter, along with her distorted personality."
Naty frowned at the metaphorical slap her mother gave her.
Sasha rolled her eyes and decided to take control before a fight broke out.
"Alright!
Let’s do the job Darling gave us and go back to his side!" She slammed the table as she stood up.
"Yes." Victoria agreed.
"That’s a good idea." Naty nodded.
"...I miss my daughter," Carmila said as she followed Sasha.
"Which one?" Natasha asked cunningly.
"You’re very funny, my daughter." Carmila rolled her eyes.
"In our family tree, more complicated than any divine pantheon, there are only mothers and daughters.
All women connected to Victor are wives and mothers, and the children we have with him are our daughters."
"Until our daughter becomes a wife too~," Natasha said cunningly.
"..." Sasha raised her hand to argue, but in the end lowered it.
It wasn’t like that detail was anything new, considering how many sisters expected that to happen in the near future.
"It’s not like that hasn’t happened before, fufufufu." Naty laughed along with Natasha.
"Metis, Nero, and Ophis are special cases." Victoria pointed out.
"Semantics." Naty and Natasha snorted.
"It’s all Darling’s fault for spoiling them too much!" Sasha huffed.

"It’s not like I would let my daughters suffer with useless men when someone exceptional already exists, and considering Darling’s possessiveness, a suitable man for our daughters might never appear," Naty said while Natasha nodded beside her.
The two women were literally made from the same mold, except for a few topics on which they disagreed, they were practically twins!
"At this rate, our divine pantheon will have an even more complicated family relationship than the Greeks," Sasha said.
"Dear, are you living in an illusion?
Our family relationship is already more complicated than the Greeks." Natasha laughed.
"Wake up to reality."
"Ugh." Sasha couldn’t deny that.
"At this rate, Darling will be called the Father of All in the future, considering all his descendants will be his children," Victoria said.
"...That’s possible.
I’m glad Darling stopped collecting more sisters." Sasha sighed.
"I think the last batch was Ariel, Hela, Dun Scaith, Albedo, and Kali, right?" Carmila said.
"Uh-huh, since that batch, he told Violet to stop looking for wives for him," Sasha said.
"...." This was new information, not even they knew that!
"When did he say that?
And how do you know?" Natasha asked.
"Violet told me, and he said it when he spent the last night alone with Violet," Sasha replied.
"That’s...
Unexpected, I thought he would be like Solomon." Carmila said.
"Darling isn’t like Solomon, remember, women fell on him like he was an irresistible sweet." Sasha raised her eyebrow imperiously at the family behind her.
She arrived first along with Violet and Ruby, and before she realized it, her entire family’s female lineage became her sisters!
That’s absurd!
"...Well, he is an irresistible sweet." Natasha licked her lips when she remembered several things not suitable for minors that she and her husband had done together.
"Indeed," Naty said with a similar expression.
"..." Sasha rolled her eyes at these women.

chapters.title: Chapter 1144: Empress Eyes.
paragraphs: Chapter 1144: Empress Eyes.
"Tell me, Eros, my son, are you a fool? Forget it, you are a Greek god." Aphrodite grumbled irritably.
"...Mother, you are insulting yourself. You are also a Greek goddess." Eros replied impertinently.
"Do not talk back to me." Aphrodite’s eyes glowed dangerously, and her mere existence made the former Greek god feel as if he were facing his own death. She did not like his tone at all.
Aphrodite was furious, and Eros knew it was his fault. Now, he didn’t know why she was furious at him, since he hadn’t done anything wrong yet.
"I warned you several times to keep your libido under control, I punished you severely, but it seems that just like Zeus’s trash, you cannot control yourself."
"Silence."
"...." Eros screamed, but no sound came out, because Aphrodite’s word was not just a command to be silent, but a declaration to reality itself.

"You are an ungrateful son. I was around in Olympus, and you never visited me. When I exiled myself, you never cared. Now that I am ’important,’ you dare to call me Mother again. Do you think I am stupid, Eros? Answer me."
"Yet it seems you think I am stupid." Aphrodite’s draconic eyes narrowed into vertical slits.

"Even knowing your attitude, I still accepted being called Mother by you again. I didn’t want to repeat the same mistakes of the past, and wanted to show myself that I had changed and grown, but... I was wrong to think that way. There is nothing wrong with me, the problem is you."

"Thanks to your connection with me, you were not caught in the conflict with the Greeks. Thanks to that same connection, you enjoy a relatively high status in the Empire, and because I am a goddess loved by many, you try to influence others for your own desires using my name."
With a gesture of her hand, several report screens appeared in front of him.
"...You were watching me?"
"Fool, you learn nothing. It’s not that you are being watched. EVERYONE is being watched." Personal privacy? Not even in their old world did that exist. Now, it exists even less.
"Using my influence, I suppressed the case and, fortunately, you did not do anything heinous, because not even my influence would protect you, but..." Aphrodite ground her teeth.
"You just had to set your eyes on my daughter, didn’t you?"
"....." Eros opened his eyes wide. He hadn’t done anything yet! He hadn’t even put his plan into action, how did she know?

"...It truly is a blessing that my daughter is very intelligent, perhaps it’s her father’s genes..." She narrowed her eyes slightly when she realized she had insulted herself, and became even angrier: "You are useless." She said in disgust.𝙛𝓻𝒆𝓮𝒘𝙚𝙗𝒏𝙤𝙫𝓮𝒍.𝓬𝒐𝙢

"Who do you think is standing before you?" Enormous wings appeared behind Aphrodite, and two horns emerged on her head. "I am a dragon goddess whose mere word shapes reality to my liking. Do you think I cannot read your mind, you fool?"
The pressure was so unbearable that Eros could no longer stand, only able to lie on the ground with a bloodied body, looking at Aphrodite in fear.

"Disappointing! You did not listen to anything I said. You should be glad it was me who came to you... If it were my husband, death would be a merciful outcome compared to the horrors you would suffer." Her voice began to soften, the wings behind her retracted and disappeared shortly after, but the horns remained on her head.
"I was always monitoring your mind, because I knew something like this would eventually happen, because gods only learn when their pride is destroyed." This was a lesson she herself had learned.
"I tried to be a good mother, tried to show that I cared, but you did not care about me... And even harbored lewd thoughts, therefore..." She smiled gently.
"You will no longer be my son."
"Do not call me that, you are unworthy." She said with disgust. "Do not worry, even if you are trash, you are trash that can be recycled." Her gaze shifted from gentle to complete indifference.
"You may take him."
"Yes."
Eros was confused about who she was speaking to, but the moment he blinked, two hooded beings were within his field of vision.

If before he felt fear toward his mother, this time he felt existential horror when he looked inside the hood. The last thing he remembered was seeing thousands of violet eyes and a huge mouth that seemed to swallow his entire being, then he fell unconscious.
Looking coldly at Eros being taken away to have his soul recycled, Aphrodite spoke:
"Thank you for your help, My Empress."
Reality began to unravel as if a curtain had fallen, soon revealing the Empress in all her immortal glory.
Unlike the gentle expression Violet always had, her current expression was pure ice. "It is something I do for my sister, even if it is a thankless task."

Aphrodite sighed. "I tried, you know? I swear I tried... But it seems the relationship was worn out from the beginning, and everything on his side was in his interest. He is like all gods, and I was foolish to delude myself."
Aphrodite knew this would happen eventually, and now that it did... She felt nothing. Absolutely nothing.

Since she left to travel and settled with Victor, she tried to be better to the people around her, and it worked. It’s no wonder that, even among her sisters, she was very loved and cherished, but the same did not apply to her son.
From the beginning, there was only indifference between them. Eros only saw her as a means to gain more influence, and even harbored obscene thoughts toward her deep down.
The truth she never wanted to face was that she did not care about anyone except Victor, Anna, and her new family. She was just trying to cling to an illusion, or one could call it self-satisfaction.

"When I joined Darling in Nightingale after his tournament, where he presented himself to the vampires, many vampire lineages were extinguished that day, because those pieces of trash dared to show interest in my Darling. The same happened with Darling when he discovered the thoughts of the men... That night was a massacre." She showed a small, cold smile.

One could say that Violet and Victor truly matched each other. Both were extremely obsessive and possessive, and both improved their temperaments over time, especially now that they are parents and have a daughter. But at any moment, that extreme personality could resurface, and with the power they now have, the destruction they could cause could not be measured.

In this specific case, Violet’s possessiveness had evolved to encompass her entire current family, which is why her expression was now exceptionally cold. The only reason she did not touch Eros was at Aphrodite’s request.
Her hand itched to grab that fool and completely destroy him until even he forgot who he was, but...

Despite being obsessive, they still respected the family they built above all. It was that same respect that kept Victor from acting against Eros long ago; after all, nothing involving his wives escaped his sight.

"...I know, you told that story with pride to us in the past." She smiled a little tiredly when she saw Violet’s love pulse like a living heart, a love so intense that it encompassed everyone she considered precious, but it was a dangerous and extremely volatile love.
’Somehow, this woman still has more love than me, and I am the goddess of love here.’ She sighed, impressed.
"What do you want to happen to him?" Violet asked.
"An attendant like Jeanne’s, since he is my son from before I became a dragon, his soul is somewhat valuable." She felt that having another goddess of love as a subordinate was not a bad idea.
"A lesser goddess of love then."
"Yes."
"I will leave the reincarnation to our sisters," Violet said.
"Thank you again for the help, and I know that—"
"Shhh." Violet placed her finger on Aphrodite’s full lips. "You are my sister, my family, you don’t need to thank me..." She showed a smile that was both gentle and extremely possessive.

"Just knowing your feelings is enough." Violet removed her finger from Aphrodite’s lips and then spoke as she slowly disappeared. "Keep up the good work, soon the ritual will end, and Darling will need a long rest~" A small, indecent smile appeared on her face.
The implications of her words were more than obvious.
When Violet completely disappeared, Aphrodite touched her lips and blushed slightly when she remembered Violet’s expression. "She is the Empress and main wife for a reason." She laughed gently.
She looked at where Eros had been before and sighed tiredly. ’It’s a good thing Darling didn’t deal with this.’ If Victor had been involved, Eros would spend eternity in existential horror.
Even though she did not like her son’s attitude, she would not wish that kind of punishment on anyone... Well, unless they were their enemies, of course, if it were them, she would have no mercy.
One could say that not involving Victor was a small act of kindness for her former son.
"Eros, huh..." Persephone looked at the soul in her hands.
"How do you want to deal with him?" she asked the Empress.
"A complete reincarnation, erase everything from him, and leave only the divinity. A new lesser goddess for our sister will be created."
"I see, that will be a bit difficult, you damaged him a little."
"He should be grateful I didn’t hand him to Darling, or his punishment would have been much worse."

True to her nature, Violet still punished him, a rather ’light’ punishment by their standards, but, of course, that was just their perspective. If someone suffered such a punishment, at the very least, they would be mentally broken.
But indeed, it was a light punishment considering the type of torture Lily performs and the kind of punishment Victor and Azathoth deliver... Yeah, he was lucky.
Violet made a gesture with her hand, and using the power of order, she corrected Eros’s soul.

"...This power never ceases to amaze me, no matter how many times I see it." Persephone sighed. To an outside observer, nothing really happened, but to her, who saw how souls functioned and was responsible for reincarnation, she could clearly see the kind of influence the concept of <ORDER> had.
"I’ll leave the work to you."
"Yes, my Empress."
Violet rolled her eyes when she heard the way Persephone addressed her. Lately, her sisters liked to act like that when she was serious...

chapters.title: Chapter 1145: Vlad Dracul Tepes’s Dilemma.
paragraphs: Chapter 1145: Vlad Dracul Tepes’s Dilemma.
As soon as the planning began, the Empire started working on genetics from the 30th millennium onward. In less than 20 thousand years, everyone began to develop even further.

An ordinary citizen of the Empire could easily lift a building in the old world, becoming truly superior beings, with lifespans increasing to 300 years. Current expectations are to increase to 400 years by the end of the 100,000th year of the imperial calendar.

But that was not the Empire’s only focus. Victor wanted to make his galaxy as impenetrable as possible, wanting the entire galaxy to be a deadly trap for anyone who did not know how to navigate these areas and to have very tragic deaths. Therefore, two superprojects began in the 70th millennium and onward: one project was placed in the hands of the dragon goddesses, who were very good at shaping reality.

With Victor sustaining the galaxy itself and keeping existence functioning, they began to ’modify’ everything, from asteroids, black holes, stars, and cosmic clouds to entire moons. Using the influence of Victor’s and Hela’s enthusiastic friends, the Eldritch creatures that Hela summoned in the war against Asgard were spread across strategic points throughout the galaxy.

With a ’small’ boost from Victor and Azathoth, these creatures became even more deadly, nothing too exaggerated like their daughter, as they did not want to draw more attention to themselves than they already did. The Empire already had its own quota of Eldritchbeings, most of them being Victor’s subordinates.

But in the grand scheme of things, the number was not as massive as expected, considering that each of these beings could easily patrol a solar system. Upon completing this project, nothing in Victor’s galaxy was safe for enemies: in every asteroid, in every star, in every black hole, there was an Eldritch creature lurking.

He made all of space as hostile as possible, taking care that the Eldritch creatures themselves did not distort everything. Fortunately, since Victor and Azathoth were like creator gods to them, these creatures obeyed easily. Thankfully, they did not need to worry about food since Victor improved their existence so that they could exist without eating now, but could still choose to eat, having full permission to annihilate enemies, even making them their personal snacks.

Eventually, 100,000 years passed, a milestone for the Empire. An event happened on that day as Victor and Violet’s avatars descended, and they held a parade with the Empire’s forces throughout the Imperial capital. This parade was seen on every planet connected to the Empire.
Nightingale, Royal Capital.
"Heh, and to think that this was my planned successor, huh. How he surpassed me." In the privacy of his castle in Nightingale, Vlad Dracul Tepes watched the parade with a neutral and amused look.

Only in his personal quarters could he be true to himself, as outside this place, everything was monitored. Not that Victor could not see this place if he wanted to, his gaze unobstructed by anything, but he deliberately did not look this way.
Both out of respect for Ophis and out of respect for Vlad himself, Victor left Vlad alone.

"And to think that only six months have passed." Vlad was one of the few who remained outside the 200-thousand-year development project. He had the opportunity to go, but Vlad decided not to. After all, when the 200 thousand years passed, he would have several things to explore again, as everything would be new to him, and honestly, he could barely wait for that day to come.
The greatest disease of a long-lived being was boredom, and Vlad understood this very well.
"He went much further than you did, my King."

Vlad looked at Alexios Alioth, his great friend, who was now rejuvenated and at his peak. Due to his connection as one of the Emperor’s father-in-law, he practically had VIP access to the Empire’s resources, so it was easy for him to evolve into a primordial human and regain his youth. Even his power became stronger.

Vlad pursed his lips at this subordinate of his who seemed bathed in the air of life. He really did not know what to say about his servant’s shameless attitude of taking advantage of the rival Empire’s benefits while calling him my king.
"You really have changed, Alexios," Vlad said in a neutral tone, but as a good servant, Alexios could sense the disdain in his tone.
"My King, everything is for my daughter," Alexios spoke with a forced English accent. "And you cannot say that you did not take advantage of it as well."

Alexios looked at Vlad’s body, which was visibly stronger than before. He himself had ’evolved’ to the ancestral state of his race. Although he was already only one step away from this evolution before, thanks to the Empire, he reached it much more easily. He was now like the ancient vampires who first came from another planet to evolve beyond this state. It depended entirely on Vlad, and thanks to the Empire’s technology, Vlad could now eat food normally. After all, a racial trait that was tied to only one food was a great weakness. Something the Empire considered very undignified, and therefore, they fixed most of the basic weaknesses of a Noble Vampire.
"Everything is for my daughter, Ophis," Vlad replied in the same forced British English tone Alexios had used earlier when questioned.

Alexios rolled his eyes, then returned to looking at the parade. With only a superficial glance at the beings near the Emperor, he knew that if Victor sent only them, they could easily destroy Nightingale. Vlad was strong and had become even stronger thanks to the upgrades he underwent, but in the end, it did not matter when the power gap was simply too great.
Especially when most of his imperial guard entourage could easily invade a high-level pantheon and destroy them.
"The strength my son-in-law has is impressive."

’Impressive is an understatement. If I had only his imperial guards, I could conquer the world 777 times, and not once would I lose.’ Vlad thought, but did not say it. He needed to maintain his dignity as a king, but he could not deny that he felt a little envious of Victor’s military might. It was simply too incredible. Everyone in the imperial guard protecting the royal family could fight against a first-generation primordial god like Nyx in the past. Which is ridiculous if you think about it.

’The enemy must truly be very strong if he needs this kind of strength in the future.’ Vlad thought. He did not want to admit it, but he was getting excited. It had been a long time since he had encountered such a great unknown, and even stronger enemies, and if he fought under the Empire’s banner, he could fight without worrying and simply have fun.

The old monster wanted to have fun too. What was the point of ruling if the owner of the entire planet, and the world’s tree of the planet, was another empire? He had simply not been stripped of his power out of respect.
"The objective, as expected, is to show strength?" Alexios spoke.

"Yes. Some beings have been acting very arrogantly lately, and this is a way to put them in their place." Vlad knew very well that the lives of these unstable seeds were already approaching their end. When the war happened, they would be the first to be sacrificed. How did he know this? It was simple; if he were in Victor’s place, he would do the same, as no ruler liked rebellious thoughts among their people.

Vlad could have done the same in the past, but Victor’s connections were simply too troublesome, and in a way, he was glad he had not done so. Despite everything that had happened between him and Victor, their relationship was cordial nowadays, even respectful. The bridge between them remained Ophis.

’I think it is already time for Ophis to marry him.’ Vlad thought. This thought initially caused great and deep displeasure in his heart. He felt as if his carefully tended cabbage had been stolen in the middle of the night by some pig.

But after thinking objectively with his kingly side, he realized that there were countless advantages, so great that they outweighed the rebellion in his heart. Not to mention that this was a reality that Ophis herself also wanted.
And Vlad could not go against Ophis’s wishes, even if he wanted to. If he forced the situation too much, she would beat him up. The sad fact was that she really could do that now.

’She grew up and became very filial to her old man... I guess that is the fate of all daughters. Except for that madman’s daughters. Why are his daughters so obsessed with him? What envy, I need to know his ways.’ Vlad thought enviously.
"Time really makes people forget," Alexios spoke while shaking his head in disdain. These people were simply crazy if they saw this parade and thought they could deal with the Empire.

"It is inevitable. There will always be ambitious beings. People who grew up in the Imperial era are loyal to the Empire, but there will always be those who think, if I were in his place, couldn’t I do better? I want this power too, I am envious, I want more, etc." Vlad spoke. As a ruler, he knew this very well.𝐟𝕣𝗲𝕖𝕨𝗲𝐛𝗻𝗼𝐯𝗲𝚕.𝗰𝚘𝐦
This was one of the reasons true peace could not exist: sentient beings themselves. Even if there were only two people on the planet, there would inevitably be conflicts between them.
"An idiotic thought considering their reality," Alexios spoke.

"Well, I never said it wasn’t. Fools prosper if left unchecked." Vlad looked at Ophis, who was watching the parade as one of the legion commanders in her divine armor with pride. ’She has become an extraordinarily powerful goddess.’
Ophis already had an absurd amount of potential considering her lineage, and thanks to Victor, she became even stronger, and her potential rose even further.
"Fortunately, Victor knows this, and keeps the reins tight."
Alexios nodded. Victor’s presence in that parade was the perfect proof of his previous considerations. ’I said he would become a great king.’ He laughed internally.

For Alexios, this entire situation was a great victory. His bloodline was safe, and his daughter had become strong, much stronger than him, and his granddaughter was following her mother’s path. He felt that several responsibilities he had before no longer existed. He was feeling very free at that moment.
"I hope the others watching this parade think the same."

"I doubt it. After all, I do not doubt the delusions of fools." Vlad spoke with absolute certainty. Even though it was a small number of fools, they still existed. It would be strange if they did not.

sentences.text: Chapter 1145: Vlad Dracul Tepes’s Dilemma.
As soon as the planning began, the Empire started working on genetics from the 30th millennium onward.
In less than 20 thousand years, everyone began to develop even further.
An ordinary citizen of the Empire could easily lift a building in the old world, becoming truly superior beings, with lifespans increasing to 300 years.
Current expectations are to increase to 400 years by the end of the 100,000th year of the imperial calendar.
But that was not the Empire’s only focus.
Victor wanted to make his galaxy as impenetrable as possible, wanting the entire galaxy to be a deadly trap for anyone who did not know how to navigate these areas and to have very tragic deaths.
Therefore, two superprojects began in the 70th millennium and onward: one project was placed in the hands of the dragon goddesses, who were very good at shaping reality.
With Victor sustaining the galaxy itself and keeping existence functioning, they began to ’modify’ everything, from asteroids, black holes, stars, and cosmic clouds to entire moons.
Using the influence of Victor’s and Hela’s enthusiastic friends, the Eldritch creatures that Hela summoned in the war against Asgard were spread across strategic points throughout the galaxy.

With a ’small’ boost from Victor and Azathoth, these creatures became even more deadly, nothing too exaggerated like their daughter, as they did not want to draw more attention to themselves than they already did.
The Empire already had its own quota of Eldritchbeings, most of them being Victor’s subordinates.
But in the grand scheme of things, the number was not as massive as expected, considering that each of these beings could easily patrol a solar system.
Upon completing this project, nothing in Victor’s galaxy was safe for enemies: in every asteroid, in every star, in every black hole, there was an Eldritch creature lurking.
He made all of space as hostile as possible, taking care that the Eldritch creatures themselves did not distort everything.
Fortunately, since Victor and Azathoth were like creator gods to them, these creatures obeyed easily.

Thankfully, they did not need to worry about food since Victor improved their existence so that they could exist without eating now, but could still choose to eat, having full permission to annihilate enemies, even making them their personal snacks.
Eventually, 100,000 years passed, a milestone for the Empire.
An event happened on that day as Victor and Violet’s avatars descended, and they held a parade with the Empire’s forces throughout the Imperial capital.
This parade was seen on every planet connected to the Empire.
Nightingale, Royal Capital.
"Heh, and to think that this was my planned successor, huh.
How he surpassed me." In the privacy of his castle in Nightingale, Vlad Dracul Tepes watched the parade with a neutral and amused look.
Only in his personal quarters could he be true to himself, as outside this place, everything was monitored.
Not that Victor could not see this place if he wanted to, his gaze unobstructed by anything, but he deliberately did not look this way.
Both out of respect for Ophis and out of respect for Vlad himself, Victor left Vlad alone.
"And to think that only six months have passed." Vlad was one of the few who remained outside the 200-thousand-year development project.
He had the opportunity to go, but Vlad decided not to.
After all, when the 200 thousand years passed, he would have several things to explore again, as everything would be new to him, and honestly, he could barely wait for that day to come.
The greatest disease of a long-lived being was boredom, and Vlad understood this very well.
"He went much further than you did, my King."
Vlad looked at Alexios Alioth, his great friend, who was now rejuvenated and at his peak.
Due to his connection as one of the Emperor’s father-in-law, he practically had VIP access to the Empire’s resources, so it was easy for him to evolve into a primordial human and regain his youth.
Even his power became stronger.
Vlad pursed his lips at this subordinate of his who seemed bathed in the air of life.
He really did not know what to say about his servant’s shameless attitude of taking advantage of the rival Empire’s benefits while calling him my king.
"You really have changed, Alexios," Vlad said in a neutral tone, but as a good servant, Alexios could sense the disdain in his tone.
"My King, everything is for my daughter," Alexios spoke with a forced English accent.
"And you cannot say that you did not take advantage of it as well."
Alexios looked at Vlad’s body, which was visibly stronger than before.
He himself had ’evolved’ to the ancestral state of his race.
Although he was already only one step away from this evolution before, thanks to the Empire, he reached it much more easily.
He was now like the ancient vampires who first came from another planet to evolve beyond this state.
It depended entirely on Vlad, and thanks to the Empire’s technology, Vlad could now eat food normally.
After all, a racial trait that was tied to only one food was a great weakness.
Something the Empire considered very undignified, and therefore, they fixed most of the basic weaknesses of a Noble Vampire.

Alexios rolled his eyes, then returned to looking at the parade.
With only a superficial glance at the beings near the Emperor, he knew that if Victor sent only them, they could easily destroy Nightingale.
Vlad was strong and had become even stronger thanks to the upgrades he underwent, but in the end, it did not matter when the power gap was simply too great.
Especially when most of his imperial guard entourage could easily invade a high-level pantheon and destroy them.

chapters.title: Chapter 1146: Those Who Never Change.
paragraphs: Chapter 1146: Those Who Never Change.
In a bar, Andrew, Edward, and Fred looked at the parade with a look full of admiration.
"Our friend has become absurd," Fred said. "He became a Warhammer emperor."
"Idiot, do you want to get banned? Stop that." Andrew hit him on the head. "Fix that wall already!"
"Tsk, fine." Fred took some duct tape and quickly fixed the slightly cracked fourth wall.
"You guys don’t change, huh? Still idiots."
"..." Fred and Andrew looked at the werewolf and rolled their eyes.
Andrew snorted: "Says the shiny vampire. Did you get some sunlight today?"
"Andrew, Andrew, you know he can’t," Fred spoke.
"Ah, that’s right. If he gets some sunlight, he’ll shine like a princess."
"HAHAHAHAHAHAH!" The two laughed mockingly.
Veins bulged on Edward’s head. Years had passed, but this joke remained just as annoying as ever. He wasn’t a vampire, damn it! He was a werewolf!
"So these are your friends, Leader. They are... Peculiar."
"..." Edward looked at Johnny, his older brother from another mother, and then looked at Adam, his father, who was drinking in silence.
"For God’s sake, you’re my brother, you can act normally when we’re not in the Clan’s territory."
"Respect is necessary for the new Alpha."
Edward rolled his eyes and muttered under his breath. "It’s not like I wanted to become the Alpha, it’s a thankless job."
"Observe the attitude of your older brother, Alpha. That’s what a true subordinate is, HAHAHAHAHAHA." Adam laughed.
More veins popped out on Edward’s head: "You clearly don’t respect me."
"Why should I? I’m retired." Adam smiled with that annoying smile that reminded him of Victor.

Edward had always thought that Victor was heavily influenced by his father, but now he was certain that it was true. Honestly, Edward was very envious of his father; he wanted to be retired too! Damn it, being the leader was exceptionally annoying!
The bar’s door opened, and soon four white-haired women entered: Maya Elizabeth Elderblood, Leona Elizabeth Elderblood, Bellatrix Lykos, and Leone Elena Luna Elderblood, Leona and Victor’s daughter.
"Hmm? What are you doing here, Leona? Shouldn’t you be at the parade?" Fred asked.
"Only the legion commanders, the Empress, the Emperor, and the supreme commander are participating, and my position is currently being occupied by my sister; therefore, I’m off~."
"Leone!!!" Adam ran and hugged Leone.
"Gah, Grandpa, stop that!" Reacting on instinct, Leone gave her grandfather a German suplex, and the sounds of bones breaking could be heard.
"... Still strong as ever." He gave a thumbs-up while remaining on the floor.
"Humpf." She snorted.

Leone was a tall girl due to her family’s genes. She was 185 CM tall, with long snow-white hair that reached her waist, a toned body from training, a slender figure, and deep violet eyes that were common among Victor’s children.

She looked like a younger version of Leona with violet eyes, but if you looked carefully, you would see that she inherited Victor’s face. And considering that he was the personification of beauty, she was extremely beautiful, just like all of his daughters.
Edward, Leona, Bellatrix, and Johnny put their hands on their faces in exasperation.
"How did my father evolve into this old man when my daughter is present?" Leona asked.
"Honestly, that’s something I want to understand too," Edward said.
The door opened again, as another woman entered.
"Mira, you’re here." Maya smiled gently.
"Yes, Mother."

Mirabelle Elizabeth Elderblood, Maya and Victor’s daughter, like her sister Leone, inherited quite a lot of the characteristics of the Lykos Clan, with the only difference being that her body was more voluptuous. She completely inherited her mother’s tanned skin tone, with deep violet eyes, short snow-white hair that reached her neck, and a voluptuous and toned body with six-pack abs, very typical of the girls of the Lykos Clan. She was a little shorter than her sister, standing at only 182 CM tall.
"Honestly, Victor’s genes are wildly unfair. How the hell are his daughters so beautiful?" Andrew couldn’t help but comment.
"Are you calling my sister ugly?" Edward, Adam, who had suddenly stood up, and Johnny looked at Andrew with a look that said: choose your words carefully.
Andrew began to be covered with a cold sweat, and quickly added: "That’s not it, I’m just saying it seems like Victor blessed them or something. The beauty is clearly his!"
"Dude, that sounded very suspicious. Are you okay?" Fred shuddered. "I know that with that face, he is objectively handsome, but he is a man."
This time, it was Victor’s daughters, along with Maya and Leona, who looked at the duo with an expression similar to the Lykos men’s, being very possessive of Victor.
"Fred, don’t provoke them! You’re digging my grave here along with me!"
"Damn, that’s true," Fred muttered when he saw the women’s looks.
Leona rolled her eyes and spoke: "Forget the two fools, let’s sit down."
"Yes, Mother." Like two well-behaved ducklings, the daughters followed their mothers.
Andrew and Fred sighed in relief when they were saved by Leona.
The Elderblood women sat together, Bella sitting closer to Maya, and soon they began watching the parade.
"Johnny, where are your wives?" Maya asked.
"Taking care of the children."

After Jessica, his former lover, left and revealed herself to be someone from the Snow vampire lineage, Johnny began to value his companions more. Nowadays, he had even had children who were still young. After all, not everyone had gods of time in their family.
Victor’s family was the strange one for suddenly appearing with a bunch of already-adult children.
Even Maya herself became calmer after finding a strong partner. She stopped walking around looking for fights and was more at peace, focusing on the family’s projects and on training her daughters.

She wasn’t the only one, as the same could be said about many of Victor’s more impatient women. They had calmed down considerably with time, but behind that calmness was still the same personality as before. They simply didn’t need to express themselves as they had before.
"Here, take some water and stop making suspicious comments, dude."
"Thanks, and you’re right... Pfft." He spat it out. "This isn’t water, it’s pure alcohol!"
"It’s crystal clear, therefore, it’s water." Fred smiled while drinking.
"How the hell do you have a wife? How does she put up with you?"
"It’s simple, she’s just like me." He raised his chin proudly.
"Didn’t you have a harem?" Andrew narrowed his eyes.
"So what?"
"Are they all like you?"
"... That’s impossible. Do you think I have clones like my women or something?"
"Then how do they all put up with you?"
Fred clapped his hands and a rainbow formed: "Magik."
"I hate you."
"I know you don’t." Fred laughed.
Andrew snorted and went back to calmly drinking the ’water.’ With his new biology, it would be very difficult for him to get drunk.

Andrew, Edward, and Fred had basically won at life. As Victor’s close friends, they were quite influential and sought after by women. Don’t be fooled by their behavior in the bar, they were acting like this because they were in the company of trusted friends. Outside, they were quite feared and respected. There was a reason why they could have a harem, after all.

"Seeing you two react like this reminds me of the time when Victor was like this too," Leona remembered the time when Victor was around 10 years old, and he acted like a typical arrogant idiot of a child. Due to his illness, he became much quieter as time passed.
"He was a troublesome brat." Adam laughed. It could be said that he, Edward, and Leona were the ones who followed Victor the most as he grew up, followed shortly afterward by Andrew and Freed.
"Sometimes I envy you for having known him for so long," Maya said.
"Well, even if you had seen Victor in the past, you wouldn’t even have looked at him," Leona said.

"... That’s true." There was no point in sugarcoating the pill, as that was the absolute truth. She became interested in Victor because he was strong. If it weren’t for that fact, she wouldn’t even have looked at him.

The same applied to several other women in the Harem. Only Violet [being a stalker], Leona, and Anna had been with him from the beginning, and that was precisely why they had such a high hierarchy in the family.
While the people around them talked, Victor’s two daughters remained silent as they observed everything. This was the first time they had met their father’s old friends.
[They seem weak.] Mira made an objective comment to her sister.
Leone replied mentally. [Everyone can be considered weak compared to us, sister.]
[That’s true, but as friends of our beloved father, they should be strong, shouldn’t they?] Mira insisted.
[Hmm, perhaps they’re hiding their power?]
[From our eyes?] Mira asked incredulously. [Impossible, they are far too weak for that. I could understand our mother hiding it from us, after all, they are strong, but them? Completely Impossible.]
[Yes, but they are our father’s friends, right? They must have something special.] Leone spoke.
[Hmm, that’s possible.] Mira did not deny it.

All of Victor’s daughters, without exception, inherited some kind of perception related to their eyes. The degree varied, with some born with this gift extremely strong, others born with it very weak, while many just had a reasonable level of power, but all of them without exception had it and could develop it further. Birth only indicated the starting point they had to train from. Because of this, all of them had deep violet eyes.
These eyes were similar to Victor’s, eyes that could see through the truth of the world. Nothing could be hidden from them.

While the two conversed mentally, Maya and Leona looked at each other with amused eyes. They were hearing everything their daughters were saying. Victor’s daughters were very biased toward their own Father. If other daughters were here, they would do the same thing.
The prejudice was very strong, and almost no one could earn their approval. Fortunately, their mothers had taught them well, so they would not behave like spoiled brats.
"Leona, can you ask the Divine Commander to train my children?"
"...." The entire group fell silent when they heard Johnny’s words.

Mari and Leone were the most shocked. After all, they knew their mother’s training regimen very well. Only sadistic lunatics would find that appropriate. They endured it because they were their father’s daughters; if it weren’t for that, it would be impossible.

Despite Scathach’s title officially being supreme commander of the Empire’s forces, many civilians, including deities, called her the Divine Commander, which was not an inappropriate title considering she commanded gods.
"My son, I may be sadistic and carefree, but even I wouldn’t send my children to that woman. Are you right in the head? No offense, my daughter." Adam spoke.
"I wasn’t offended. After all, it’s true." Leona shrugged. Even she thought that way. If she didn’t know her daughters’ abilities, she wouldn’t let Scathach train them.
"It’s fine. They won’t die, and even if they do, they can come back to life. What doesn’t kill them makes them stronger, and I don’t want my children to be weak."
"... That’s a carefree way of saying it," Edward said. He would never send his children to Scathach, never.
"It’s a good decision. The children will grow strong and disciplined." Maya nodded in agreement with Johnny’s decision.
’Of course you would agree, you’re just as crazy as that woman.’ Adam, Edward, Bellatrix, and Leona thought.

"I can ask Scathach to train them as a favor, and she will do it, but her standards are very high. Are you sure about this? They will suffer a lot. Honestly, at this point, it’s better to leave them to the enemies. I’m sure the enemies will be kinder than Scathach."
Johnny didn’t even think: "Yes."
"Very well, when they turn 21, just send them to the imperial capital." That was the imperial legal age if one wanted to join the army.
"Isn’t 21 years old too late?"

"Are you trying to make your children her disciples? That’s impossible. I can ask her to train them, but to become disciples, the decision is completely hers. She only gives attention to those who have raw talent." Leona explained. Even she couldn’t change this principle of Scathach.
What she could do was make Scathach give an individual a little more attention, but that wasn’t necessarily good for that individual. Everyone who knew Scathach’s training method knew this.

"I understand." Johnny was a little disappointed, but there was nothing more he could do. Insisting beyond this would be forcing the situation, and he would not do that. Everything depended on his children now.

She completely inherited her mother’s tanned skin tone, with deep violet eyes, short snow-white hair that reached her neck, and a voluptuous and toned body with six-pack abs, very typical of the girls of the Lykos Clan.
She was a little shorter than her sister, standing at only 182 CM tall.
"Honestly, Victor’s genes are wildly unfair.
How the hell are his daughters so beautiful?" Andrew couldn’t help but comment.
"Are you calling my sister ugly?" Edward, Adam, who had suddenly stood up, and Johnny looked at Andrew with a look that said: choose your words carefully.
Andrew began to be covered with a cold sweat, and quickly added: "That’s not it, I’m just saying it seems like Victor blessed them or something.
The beauty is clearly his!"
"Dude, that sounded very suspicious.
Are you okay?" Fred shuddered.
"I know that with that face, he is objectively handsome, but he is a man."
This time, it was Victor’s daughters, along with Maya and Leona, who looked at the duo with an expression similar to the Lykos men’s, being very possessive of Victor.
"Fred, don’t provoke them!
You’re digging my grave here along with me!"
"Damn, that’s true," Fred muttered when he saw the women’s looks.
Leona rolled her eyes and spoke: "Forget the two fools, let’s sit down."
"Yes, Mother." Like two well-behaved ducklings, the daughters followed their mothers.
Andrew and Fred sighed in relief when they were saved by Leona.
The Elderblood women sat together, Bella sitting closer to Maya, and soon they began watching the parade.
"Johnny, where are your wives?" Maya asked.
"Taking care of the children."
After Jessica, his former lover, left and revealed herself to be someone from the Snow vampire lineage, Johnny began to value his companions more.
Nowadays, he had even had children who were still young.
After all, not everyone had gods of time in their family.
Victor’s family was the strange one for suddenly appearing with a bunch of already-adult children.
Even Maya herself became calmer after finding a strong partner.
She stopped walking around looking for fights and was more at peace, focusing on the family’s projects and on training her daughters.
She wasn’t the only one, as the same could be said about many of Victor’s more impatient women.
They had calmed down considerably with time, but behind that calmness was still the same personality as before.
They simply didn’t need to express themselves as they had before.
"Here, take some water and stop making suspicious comments, dude."
"Thanks, and you’re right...
Pfft." He spat it out.
"This isn’t water, it’s pure alcohol!"
"It’s crystal clear, therefore, it’s water." Fred smiled while drinking.
"How the hell do you have a wife?
How does she put up with you?"
"It’s simple, she’s just like me." He raised his chin proudly.
"Didn’t you have a harem?" Andrew narrowed his eyes.
"So what?"
"Are they all like you?"
That’s impossible.
Do you think I have clones like my women or something?"
"Then how do they all put up with you?"
Fred clapped his hands and a rainbow formed: "Magik."
"I hate you."
"I know you don’t." Fred laughed.
Andrew snorted and went back to calmly drinking the ’water.’ With his new biology, it would be very difficult for him to get drunk.
Andrew, Edward, and Fred had basically won at life.
As Victor’s close friends, they were quite influential and sought after by women.
Don’t be fooled by their behavior in the bar, they were acting like this because they were in the company of trusted friends.
Outside, they were quite feared and respected.
There was a reason why they could have a harem, after all.

"Seeing you two react like this reminds me of the time when Victor was like this too," Leona remembered the time when Victor was around 10 years old, and he acted like a typical arrogant idiot of a child.
Due to his illness, he became much quieter as time passed.
"He was a troublesome brat." Adam laughed.
It could be said that he, Edward, and Leona were the ones who followed Victor the most as he grew up, followed shortly afterward by Andrew and Freed.
"Sometimes I envy you for having known him for so long," Maya said.
"Well, even if you had seen Victor in the past, you wouldn’t even have looked at him," Leona said.
That’s true." There was no point in sugarcoating the pill, as that was the absolute truth.
She became interested in Victor because he was strong.
If it weren’t for that fact, she wouldn’t even have looked at him.
The same applied to several other women in the Harem.
Only Violet [being a stalker], Leona, and Anna had been with him from the beginning, and that was precisely why they had such a high hierarchy in the family.
While the people around them talked, Victor’s two daughters remained silent as they observed everything.
This was the first time they had met their father’s old friends.
[They seem weak.] Mira made an objective comment to her sister.
Leone replied mentally.
[Everyone can be considered weak compared to us, sister.]
[That’s true, but as friends of our beloved father, they should be strong, shouldn’t they?] Mira insisted.
[Hmm, perhaps they’re hiding their power?]
[From our eyes?] Mira asked incredulously.
[Impossible, they are far too weak for that.
I could understand our mother hiding it from us, after all, they are strong, but them?
Completely Impossible.]
[Yes, but they are our father’s friends, right?
They must have something special.] Leone spoke.
[Hmm, that’s possible.] Mira did not deny it.
All of Victor’s daughters, without exception, inherited some kind of perception related to their eyes.

The degree varied, with some born with this gift extremely strong, others born with it very weak, while many just had a reasonable level of power, but all of them without exception had it and could develop it further.
Birth only indicated the starting point they had to train from.
Because of this, all of them had deep violet eyes.
These eyes were similar to Victor’s, eyes that could see through the truth of the world.
Nothing could be hidden from them.
While the two conversed mentally, Maya and Leona looked at each other with amused eyes.
They were hearing everything their daughters were saying.
Victor’s daughters were very biased toward their own Father.
If other daughters were here, they would do the same thing.
The prejudice was very strong, and almost no one could earn their approval.
Fortunately, their mothers had taught them well, so they would not behave like spoiled brats.
"Leona, can you ask the Divine Commander to train my children?"
"...." The entire group fell silent when they heard Johnny’s words.
Mari and Leone were the most shocked.
After all, they knew their mother’s training regimen very well.
Only sadistic lunatics would find that appropriate.
They endured it because they were their father’s daughters; if it weren’t for that, it would be impossible.

Despite Scathach’s title officially being supreme commander of the Empire’s forces, many civilians, including deities, called her the Divine Commander, which was not an inappropriate title considering she commanded gods.
"My son, I may be sadistic and carefree, but even I wouldn’t send my children to that woman.
Are you right in the head?
No offense, my daughter." Adam spoke.
"I wasn’t offended.
After all, it’s true." Leona shrugged.
Even she thought that way.
If she didn’t know her daughters’ abilities, she wouldn’t let Scathach train them.
"It’s fine.
They won’t die, and even if they do, they can come back to life.
What doesn’t kill them makes them stronger, and I don’t want my children to be weak."
That’s a carefree way of saying it," Edward said.
He would never send his children to Scathach, never.
"It’s a good decision.
The children will grow strong and disciplined." Maya nodded in agreement with Johnny’s decision.
’Of course you would agree, you’re just as crazy as that woman.’ Adam, Edward, Bellatrix, and Leona thought.
"I can ask Scathach to train them as a favor, and she will do it, but her standards are very high.
Are you sure about this?
They will suffer a lot.
Honestly, at this point, it’s better to leave them to the enemies.
I’m sure the enemies will be kinder than Scathach."
Johnny didn’t even think: "Yes."
"Very well, when they turn 21, just send them to the imperial capital." That was the imperial legal age if one wanted to join the army.
"Isn’t 21 years old too late?"
"Are you trying to make your children her disciples?
That’s impossible.
I can ask her to train them, but to become disciples, the decision is completely hers.
She only gives attention to those who have raw talent." Leona explained.
Even she couldn’t change this principle of Scathach.
What she could do was make Scathach give an individual a little more attention, but that wasn’t necessarily good for that individual.
Everyone who knew Scathach’s training method knew this.
"I understand." Johnny was a little disappointed, but there was nothing more he could do.
Insisting beyond this would be forcing the situation, and he would not do that.
Everything depended on his children now.

paragraphs: Chapter 1147: Emperor Protects.
Freezing Hell, a place filled with pure miasma.

Lilith was looking at her daughter, Liriel Elderblood, daughter of two Progenitors of two different races. She was what the texts defined as having unlimited potential. She had fully inherited the powers of a true dragon and a true demon, but not everything was flowers, as she had also inherited the defective characteristics of both races, such as extreme pride. Therefore, she was one of the daughters who needed the most attention.
"Again," Lilith ordered.

"Yes, Mother." She stood up as her body began to heal. She was tall, standing at 190 CM, with a curvy body, deep violet eyes, black hair made of pure miasma, and slightly pale skin. Just like Anna’s daughter with Victor, she almost looked like a female version of him.
Another reason why she needed attention was that she inherited one of the most problematic characteristics Victor gained by killing an Elder God.

Instant evolution. If she suffered an attack, that attack, the second time she suffered it, would become completely useless. Unfortunately, it was not a conceptual evolution like her father’s, which allowed him to ignore conceptual attacks and adapt to them. It was only corporeal attacks, but even that alone made her completely unbalanced, considering her other powers, as this power wasn’t even her main one.

She had the ability to control and create the miasma of Hell at extremely toxic levels. The hellfire mixed with her dragon fire was extremely dangerous, and the basic understanding of creating portals to any hell she wanted was also something problematic for an enemy to deal with. She was like a Raid Boss focused on negative conditions, where with every negative condition imposed on the enemy, she became stronger. She was extremely annoying to deal with.

And this fighting style was only her basic version, as when she combined the two natures of her parents, she could do even more things, and that’s without considering that she also had access to the draconic language and was very proficient in it.

The attacks resumed. Lilith was not teaching her daughter; she was genuinely fighting with her. She left the teachings for Scathach to handle. Lilith believed that the best thing she could teach her daughter was real combat, and that was what she was doing.

And this training philosophy worked very well with Liriel, considering her ability to evolve. Because of this, Scathach and Victor did not interfere with her training. And it wasn’t as if Liriel didn’t like these fights either since, just like her father, she loved every second of it and never complained.
Getting irritated because she wasn’t hitting her mother, Liriel growled. Dragon fire mixed with hellfire formed in her mouth. Her features became more draconic, and her mouth opened as she roared.
ROOOAARRR.
Seeing that beam of pure destruction approaching, Lilith sighed.
"Again, you lose yourself too easily in your nature. In a high-level fight, show emotions if you want, but always keep-." With pure speed alone, she approached behind her daughter.
But before she could get close, her daughter’s claws were at her neck.
"... Always keep your mind calm, right? Mother."
Lilith blinked in surprise, then smiled: "Correct."
Suddenly, Lilith vanished and reappeared behind her daughter, her claws around her neck.
"... Bending reality isn’t fair," Liriel grumbled.

"The enemy won’t care about that. Honor the blood in your veins. You are a demon and a dragon, your father’s daughter. We do everything to win. Being proud is good, but don’t drown in that pride and lose sight of the main objective, understood?"
"Yes, Mother."𝚏𝗿𝗲𝐞𝐰𝚎𝕓𝐧𝚘𝘃𝗲𝐥.𝐜𝚘𝕞
"Good."
The two separated, and Lilith looked at her daughter with pride: "I see that you are controlling your own nature more."
"Yeah, Yeah, if I didn’t learn after so many lessons, I wouldn’t be my father’s daughter." She snorted proudly.
Lilith’s lips twitched, and she sighed. ’Just what did Victor give these girls to make them so obsessed?’ She grumbled.
"Are you ready?" Lilith asked seriously.
"Yes."

Another reason Lilith was training her so intensely was because she would eventually inherit the position of commander of one of the legions. Victor and his wives had never forbidden any of their daughters from walking their own paths. Whatever they wanted to do was up to them.

And Liriel, just like Scathach and Victor’s daughter, Siren Elderblood, were among the daughters who wanted to help their father in the Empire; because of this, their training was more intense than normal. They did not want to lose to Nero, Ophis, and Metis, who were already working in the Empire and helping their father, nor to their sister Velina, daughter of Velnorah and Victor, who was already working as a scientist with her mother.

"Remember your training, remember who you are, my daughter. You are very capable, my daughter, but don’t become arrogant. If you don’t know how to solve something, seek the family. Always seek the family. We are here to support you, forever and ever."
"Yes. Mother. I will remember... And I will always rely on the family." She spoke with a gentle smile on her face.
"Good." Lilith smiled.
"My subjects of the Empire."
Victor’s voice suddenly echoed in everyone’s minds.

"Father!!!" Liriel’s eyes shone with excitement, and she quickly created a screen showing the Empire’s parade, where Victor was shown in his Emperor form, standing while speaking to countless worlds. Violet was beside him, as beautiful and divine as always, her crown rotating slightly, and her violet eyes shining dangerously.

Lilith’s lips visibly twitched, and a vein popped on her head. ’One day, I will discover what Victor is giving his daughters to make them love him so much.’ She thought. She knew he wasn’t doing anything, but she was being petty. She was here having her mother-and-daughter moment, and just one word from Victor was enough for Liriel to completely forget about her.

Victor stood up from the throne, and under his crimson-violet gaze, everyone with petty thoughts lowered their heads. Those with faithful thoughts looked at him with an even more fanatical gaze. After all, this was the first time most of those present had seen the Emperor so closely.

"100 thousand imperial years have passed since the Empire was created. Countless generations have passed. Some of you have been with me since the beginning, while others have already gone on to their next great journey. Regardless of who you are, I have been with you since the beginning."
"The Empire has grown and become stronger, but... It is still not enough." Victor raised his hand and, with a gesture, showed everyone the enemies encountered outside this sector.

"We are in a small bubble, a small bubble that one day will burst, revealing us to an even greater cosmos, and at that moment... A great war will begin, a war never before seen or experienced by anyone."
"We only have two choices: fight and conquer for our right to exist, or die in servitude."
"And I-..." Victor’s eyes shone, and his overwhelming presence was felt by everyone. "I refuse to kneel."
"They will kneel before us."
"Do not fear war, do not fear death, because I will be with you at all times. This is my promise as your Emperor. Even if my body falls, even if I die, your soul will be safe with me."

A purple power emanated from Victor’s words, and all the beings present, even the gods, felt an unbreakable bond with Victor. It was the Emperor’s promise that even if his body were to be destroyed, their souls would be safe, and, for the gods, who understood souls better, they could not help but feel conflicted.
They understood that this would prevent them from being exploited by other beings, but at the same time, they would never be free from Victor. They would forever be his servants even in death.

On the other hand, for the Empire’s most fervent believers, this was proof that they had been touched by the Emperor, their God-King. They were already crying with happiness, their faith becoming unshakable. And this feeling was present in more than 99% of the Empire. Only the longer-lived species were not completely satisfied.

"The final deadline is 100 thousand years from now... An incredibly long time for some and incredibly brief for others, a time that will pass in the blink of an eye before everyone realizes it. Remember my words: When the drums of war sound on that day, the Empire will be ready, I will be ready, and I will always be with you, protecting you."
A moment of silence was followed by a fervent roar.
"The Emperor Protects!!!"
"All hail The God Emperor!!!"
Trillions of beings stomped their feet on the ground and shouted:
"Aroo! Aroo! Aroo!"
"For The Emperor!!!"
"Aroo! Aroo! Aroo!"
"For The Emperor!!!"
"Aroo! Aroo! Aroo!"

The planet of several solar systems seemed to be trembling before the fervent emotions of trillions of beings, and those who harbored thoughts of rebellion found themselves incredibly intimidated by such fervor. Only when faced with this overwhelming pressure did they realize that their thoughts were incredibly foolish.
It was impossible for anyone to replace the Emperor. He had become irreplaceable, and even if he disappeared, who would protect them from the enemy?

Violet, who remained divinely by his side, restrained herself from making an ironic smile. She didn’t even need to use her powers to know that her sisters were going through a very difficult moment right now.
With Lilith.

"What the Hell is he talking about!? Father won’t die, I won’t allow it! I will kill everyone who threatens him." Liriel growled, her overwhelming strength being completely released due to her emotions.
"... Child, calm down. That’s just a way of speaking. He’ll be fine."
"No, No, NO! We have to protect him, put him in a hidden dimension... Yes! Hide him completely in his world, and let him be protected by us."
"Yes, I will do that. I need to communicate with my sisters and make a plan." She began muttering at high speed.
Veins began popping on Lilith’s head before she couldn’t contain herself and quickly slapped her daughter on the head.
"Stop this nonsense. Do you think your father is weak? Trust him a little more."
"But-."
"No buts. If you have time to think about nonsense, you have energy left to train."
Far from being intimidated, Liriel’s eyes shone even more dangerously. "Yes, Mother, I will become even stronger."
’Honestly, raising Lily was much easier than taking care of this child.’ Lilith sighed internally.

Something similar was happening with all of Victor’s daughters, and soon the mothers had to unite to calm their emotions. They did not react very well to Victor’s supposed ’death’; merely mentioning it made them completely crazy.
’Victor, it’s all your fault!!!’ All of Victor’s wives thought at that moment.

Victor, who heard these words, was speechless: ’What the hell did I do?’ Only when he saw the state of his daughters did he understand what had happened, and he quickly contacted all of them and calmed them down.
’Honestly, these troublesome girls.’ Despite thinking this, he smiled broadly.

’Victor, it’s all your fault!!!’ All of Victor’s wives thought at that moment.

’Honestly, these troublesome girls.’ Despite thinking this, he smiled broadly.
