chapters.title: Chapter 1148: As Expected of You, Darling.
paragraphs: Chapter 1148: As Expected of You, Darling.

After the appearance of the God Emperor and the words he spoke in the year 100,000 of the Imperial calendar, the Empire entered a frenzy of development. New discoveries in all areas were practically normal as everyone was experiencing a technological boom, which was ridiculous considering that everything was already exceptionally advanced.

It was like the first Imperial year again, where you went to sleep for one night and, the next day, something new appeared, driven by an inexplicable fervor of faith and pride in belonging to the Empire; they worked more, produced more, and even reproduced more and better and improved even further.

Consequently, Aphrodite and her goddesses became even happier for receiving more targets of faith, and making everyone reproduce like crazy. It was no longer strange for a family to have more than 100 children.
"That’s right, reproduce, more and more, don’t worry about resources, just worry about reproducing! The Empire will cover everything, HAHAHAHAHAHA!" Aphrodite laughed like a true villain.
"The more you reproduce, the more new believers I will have, and soon, I will surpass Violet!!!"
Looking at this scene were Jeanne, Victor, Violet, and Natalia.
"... I will send Scathach to control her." Violet’s lips twitched, and she spoke coldly.
"Send Anna too, and Hestia."
"... It’s a good idea." Violet thought for a little while and nodded in agreement with Jeanne’s words.
Putting Aphrodite’s craziness aside, the Empire was expanding with uncontrollable fervor. Consequently, some problems appeared, but nothing that the legions could not handle.

Victor rarely needed to interfere with anything and delegated all the work to his capable wives, but that did not mean he did not observe how the Empire grew. Before his eyes, he could see all his territory. If he focused on a citizen, he could see their past, present, and future possibilities. Combining this with the reports Akasha sent him, he was not operating in the dark.

"If it continues like this, we will achieve our objectives in just 50 millennia," Victor commented to his wives while looking through the passing years. He was accelerating time a little, and this was causing problems with energy expenditure.
"... Darling, are you okay?" Natalia asked worriedly.

"Yes, this is nothing. Actually, continuously spending my energy like this is helping me improve my control even further." Victor was not lying. This could be considered an advantage of constantly using his energy. The only time Victor had used his reserves like this in the past was when he was at war with all of Hell, or when he fought against the Elder God of Nightingale.
"With my divinity of space and time, and my improving control, I am reaching something close to infinite and perpetual energy."

"... Only you could improve in a situation like this." Violet opened her mouth incredulously. No matter how many times she said she was used to it, she was still surprised by the ridiculous ways Victor improved.

"This improvement would not be possible without you." Victor was sincere. He had completely underestimated the amount of energy used at the beginning. If it were not for his wives sharing the burden with him, he would not even have been able to think or move. He would have fallen into a coma and acted only as a walking battery until the ritual ended.
"And I was not the only one who improved." He looked at Jeanne.
"... As expected, you noticed." She smiled proudly.
Jeanne had once been the guardian of the universal tree, a primordial being. In terms of power, she was on a universal scale, losing only to Primordials Death and Infinity.

The current Jeanne had more potential than her previous version, and with constant energy expenditure, she came even closer to her previous peak. If before Jeanne could maintain only 10% to 15% of the ritual’s burden, now she could easily handle 30%, and if she forced the situation, she could maintain 40% of the entire burden. In terms of pure energy, she was only behind Victor and Azathoth now.

She had undergone a great improvement, and for a being with the magnitude of her power, this was absolutely ridiculous. After all, everyone knows that the closer one gets to the top, the harder it becomes to improve, and this was no exception even for Victor.

The only visible way for Victor to improve even further was to improve his control over absolutely everything, but that would only be a lateral improvement and not upward. For him to evolve even further into something close to a Primordial being, he needed to improve his divinity of Negativity, or evolve his Eldritch side even further. Two options, with no way to progress now. To evolve his Eldritch side, he needed his wife Azathoth, because if he tried to evolve alone, he would become the enemy of all Primordials except perhaps Jeanne’s brother, and to evolve his Negativity side, he needed the Positivity divinity that was currently in the hands of another being.
In the end, if he wanted to become stronger, he needed to go to the higher sectors.
"Of course I did. How could I not notice? I am right beside you."
"Humpf, I thought I had hidden it well."
"Nothing can be hidden from my eyes." He smiled.
"Yeah, yeah, our daughters say the same thing." She snorted.
"How much stronger did you become?" Violet asked curiously.
"In terms of energy and control? Three times stronger than my previous self." Jeanne spoke.
"I am only one step away from recovering my previous peak. I only need more authority over the rules of the universe. If I obtain something like that, I will completely surpass my previous peak."
"There are 6 of them. Some of them will serve you," Victor spoke disdainfully.
"... Hmm, or we can make new ones," Jeanne spoke after reflecting.
"That’s true, but we will think about that when we get there. There is no point in thinking about the future now." Victor spoke, and then looked at Violet, whose eyes were glowing.
"My dear, don’t look into the future." He spoke gently.
"... But Darling." Violet tried to protest, but Victor interrupted her by saying:

"Looking into the future is like looking at a distant mountain without understanding the abyss that connects it. It is a convenient power, that is true, but don’t let yourself be consumed by it. You are an Empress, you don’t need to look into the future for answers, you just need to do it yourself." Victor advised.
"...." Violet’s eyes stopped glowing and returned to their deep violet tone.
"You’re right." She sighed. "I have been relying too much on this power."

There is a reason why Victor, despite having the same power as Violet, does not use it. Looking into the future is a double-edged sword; it gives you an observation of what might happen, but for beings of their level, the future is not fixed. Therefore, looking into the future is only stressing yourself prematurely over something that may or may not happen. Instead of looking into the distant future, Victor prefers to use this ability to fight.

Every second in a battle at his level counts, so having an ability like this raises his level of precognition to an entirely different level, but even that is only one of his fighting tools. If the enemy is capable of creating a space where the rules of reality do not apply, this ability is useless, just as his speed was nullified in the fight against the Elder God of Nightingale.

The stronger Victor became, the more he realized that, in the end, the basics were what mattered most. It seemed that Scathach’s philosophy was not wrong after all, or at least this applied only to beings of the same level. Beings weaker than Victor only needed a snap of his fingers to be vaporized.
Violet approached Victor and gently hugged him. Victor laughed lightly and stroked her hair.
"Honestly, when will we be able to live in peace?" She sighed while snuggling like a cat receiving affection.
"Oh, my dear, we are at peace. If I wanted to, we could spend billions of years in peace on our planet, and no one could bother us, but-..."
"You will never lower your head," Violet answered for him.
"For us, and for our family, what kind of father and Emperor would I be if I were intimidated by worms?" He spoke with an arrogant face, clearly joking, but at the same time, not.
"Hehehe, right? We are not cowards." Violet laughed while hugging Victor even tighter.
Jeanne and Natalia rolled their eyes at their Empress’s spoiled attitude, but said nothing. It was not as if they were not used to it.
"How are the reactions of the other pantheons?" Victor asked.
"Well, as expected, some did not like it. But the leaders are very obedient."
"Hmm." Victor’s eyes narrowed slightly. "We will trust them to lure the enemy."

There was a reason why Victor did not completely eliminate those who were dissatisfied with the Empire. He would use them as bait to attract the enemies who eventually tried to infiltrate the Empire. Everyone who was dissatisfied with the Empire was already being tracked 24 hours a day. Everything they did, the Emperor knew.

Another reason was that an Empire with voices that did not support the Empire was also important, no matter how small they were. An opinion ’contrary’ to Victor’s was necessary so that this group could gather those who were dissatisfied, so that, in the end, they could be eliminated all at once, allowing new voices to join again.
He needed to maintain a balance between a tyrant and a benevolent ruler. Everything in life needed balance. This was something he had learned many years ago.
Fortunately, despite being fools for challenging the Empire, they were still smart enough not to commit any kind of crime.
Using his eyes, Victor saw beyond the realities and dimensional defenses of the Pantheons, and soon, his eyes saw his two wives, Kali and Ariel.
"How are the experiments of our daughter Melida going?"

Melida Charlotte Elderblood, the reincarnation of Merlin that Victor created. She had completely inherited her powers of controlling souls, and recently, even the ability to control Victor’s energies. She was growing strong and steady.
"Well, she is exceptional, just like all our daughters. All the results are positive. It is going so well that she is frustrated since she thought it would be more challenging." Natalia laughed.
"Her mind does not remember, but her soul does. She has already walked this path once in the past, therefore, it is understandable." Victor nodded.
"Metis and Akasha have also progressed very well. Soon, they will be good commanders." Jeanne spoke.
Metis Elderblood, her former reincarnation being the Greek Titan of wisdom, a woman whom Victor also reincarnated as his daughter.
"It all depends on them. And I don’t think Akasha wants to be a commander. She seems very happy just controlling the entire shadow Empire." Victor spoke.
"Well, the title of commander is only honorary. What she already does with your other creations is already worthy of being called the commander of a legion."
"That’s true." Victor smiled. He was very satisfied with her. After all, he created her to be the guardian of the family and the Empire. In this regard, she was doing a perfect job.

chapters.title: Chapter 1149: Heavenly Father, I Am Here to Visit.
paragraphs: Chapter 1149: Heavenly Father, I Am Here to Visit.
In a vast plain made entirely of clouds, a simple house belonging to a simple villager was present.

Walking calmly toward that house was a woman with long blonde hair and green eyes, wearing divine armor. Beside her was a woman who looked similar to her, with the only difference being that her hair was black and she had violet eyes.
"He changed the landscape again," Ariel murmured when she saw this place.
"Hmm, so this is your old house, Mother."
"Actually, this is my father’s house. I didn’t stay around here much."
"I understand."

Ariella Victoria Elderblood received the name Ariella from her mother and Victoria from her father. Ariella was born with immense power, like all of Victor’s daughters, and she almost completely inherited Victor’s black hair and violet eyes, but her face was more like her mother’s.

Born from the strongest female angel and the Dragon Emperor, Ariella was born with all 7 virtues of heaven, these same virtues being divine concepts that strengthened her. Chastity, Charity, Temperance, Diligence, Patience, Benevolence, and Humility.
Not only that, but she was also born with traces of her father’s divinity of creation. It could be said that she was a perfect angel, even if she wasn’t a complete angel.
"Hmm, I still prefer our house." She made a judgment.
"I miss my father... Why am I here? There’s nothing here... Can I blow that up? If I release a dragon breath, will it open a hole all the way to Yggdrasil?"
"Patience, daughter."
"Yes, Mother..." Ariella, with an impatient face, turned her head and began looking at the clouds, and more clouds. In fact, there were only clouds and light here!
Her violet eyes glowed slightly. She felt like blowing something up just to change the landscape here!

Ariel felt her head beginning to ache. ’How did this child inherit all 7 virtues of the angels? She doesn’t practice any of these virtues!’ The worst part was that Ariel could only blame Victor. After all, even if Ariella did not practice the 7 virtues, she would still retain her power, because, after all, she was a true dragon, a race that was compatible with all the powers of existence. Even if Ariella were absolute evil, she would still have the 7 virtues, all because of her unique biology.
Upon reaching the simple house, Ariel was going to knock on the door gently, but the door had already opened, and a voice sounded: "Come in, my daughter."
Ariel wasted no time and entered the house, and as expected, it was a simple home, but a quite comfortable one.
"Father, it’s been a while."
The Heavenly Father looked at his daughter and smiled gently: "Indeed, my daughter, I see that you are doing well. You have also become much stronger than before."
"Yes." Ariel smiled gently.
"Hmm... Why are you glowing? Are you my mother’s father? Then you’re my grandfather...? But why are you so weak?"
"Ariel!"
"... I’m sorry, Mother." She pouted and made a sulky face: "I’ll tell my father later." She muttered in a low voice, but everyone present heard it.
Ariel’s lips twitched, and the usual headache that all of Victor’s wives had returned. ’This is all Victor’s fault for spoiling them too much!’
"It’s okay, it’s okay, you don’t need to be so strict." The Heavenly Father easily realized she didn’t make those comments out of malice, but out of pure innocence.

She was like a newborn angel who was curious about everything around her. In fact, not even angels were like this, considering that they were already born with knowledge. It could be said that Ariella was truly very pure.
The Heavenly Father could not see even a trace of malice in her. ’They raised her very well.’ Just by looking at the girl, he could perceive how loved she was and the care of those around her.

"Answering your questions, compared to your father, all beings are very weak, including me, but my strengths are not in combat, but in creation. I am a creator, you see." With a gesture of his hand, a swallow was created, and it gently landed on his hand.

Ariella’s eyes, which had been staring at the house in boredom, glowed slightly when she saw what he did. "This is incredible!!! You have perfect control over this, not even a single bit of energy was wasted. I can’t do this."
Feeling a warm emotion blooming from those innocent eyes, he began to show off a little and started creating more animals.
"Ohhhh, incredible!!!"
At some point, the house, which had previously been cozy and comfortable, became a small Garden of Eden filled with small animals.
Ariel simply smiled gently while watching this scene, a scene she had never seen before with her father.
"You’re amazing, Grandpa."
"Practice makes perfect. I had many years to perfect this craft." He explained gently. "Even your father cannot surpass me when it comes to creation."
’Shit.’ Ariel immediately thought. She looked at her daughter and sighed: ’As expected.’ She felt her headache returning.

Ariella’s eyes glowed a deep violet: "I doubt it. My father is the best." She commented seriously. "He created my sisters, Akasha, Metis, Melida, and even a bunch of women to help in the Empire! Even several planets!" She defended him fervently.
’You may be a cool grandfather, but my father is the best!!!’ Just like her sisters, she was a strong defender of her father.
"...." The Heavenly Father’s lips twitched. He easily realized that commenting about her father was like stepping on a very problematic armed mine.
Ariel quickly made an X with her arms, clearly telling him to change the subject.
"Let’s agree that both of us are amazing."
"My father is better!!!" Her eyes glowed even more intensely.
"Better!!!" As her eyes began to darken dangerously, the Heavenly Father genuinely began to sweat coldly. He had already begun imagining the possible consequences if a fight happened here.
"... You’re right." And he gave up. It was better to simply satisfy the child than deal with this political problem.
"Umu." She nodded, satisfied with a genuine smile on her face. When she was about to say something, she saw something shiny in the corner, and that immediately caught her attention.
"Hmm? Shine!!!" She ran in that direction and began playing with it.
Ariel broke into a cold sweat when she saw what her daughter was playing with. It was the celestial system responsible for managing all the heavens!!!
"Ariell-"
"It’s okay. I already disconnected the system from the dimension. Nothing she does there will harm this place."
"I understand." Ariel sighed.
"I’m sorry about that, Father."
"It’s okay, hahaha." He laughed, amused. "She is a kind child who is simply protecting her father; every child has this instinct within them."
"... That’s true."

"Hmm? This is wrong. Let’s do this, and this, and this, voilà... Why isn’t it working? What a bad system. Akasha would get furious if she saw this. Let’s modify this, and this... What is a retro function? It’s so old!" Ariella grumbled as she messed with the entire celestial system.
The Heavenly Father swallowed hard when he saw the modifications she was making. In fact, calling them modifications would be an insult. She was practically writing a new source code from scratch.
Seeing what she was doing, he was genuinely surprised by how much better the system was, but it wasn’t his fault. If he sought to progress, he could have created something better.

Unlike the Empire, which was always improving itself, the Heavenly Father was stagnant. If he so desired and put his genius toward creating and innovating, he would be unstoppable on the same level as Velnorah or even higher. No matter how much potential you have, if you stop walking, other people will surpass you.
"... Her potential is unbelievable. She would make a good successor."
"It all depends on her," Ariel spoke. "We don’t forbid her from anything. She will walk her own path."
"Free will, I respect that." He nodded, satisfied.
"I presume you didn’t come here just to show me my granddaughter, right?"
"Yes." Ariel assumed a serious expression: "What do you think of my husband’s announcement?"

"Understandable, I would do the same." Every leader had their pride, and he was no different, although the Heavenly Father was a little more flexible. For example, he preferred being subordinate to Victor rather than to some foreign god.𝒇𝒓𝒆𝒆𝙬𝒆𝒃𝓷𝒐𝓿𝙚𝙡.𝒄𝓸𝒎

That was because he saw Victor as his own creation, which in a way was not wrong. Not long ago, Victor’s soul was linked to the Heavenly Father. If he died while still young, he would go to the Heavenly Father, and was therefore a descendant of Adam. It was better to be the subordinate of your own creation than of some arrogant foreign god.
"I understand, I’m glad about that." Ariel sighed and then raised her hand, and a golden power formed in the shape of a sphere.
"... What is this?"
"Knowledge from my sister Velnorah, Ruby, and Aline about angel biology, and ways to improve it, making it something closer to gods, and the power of creation that my husband gave me for you."
"I understand... He is strengthening his allies, huh."

"In the war that will come, the minimum power necessary to intervene in a fight is that of a lower-level fighting god. In our systems, we categorize these beings as CODE: V-03 – Continental Level, beings capable of destroying entire continents, and these are only foot soldiers."
"... They are that strong?" If foot soldiers were already at this level, the level of the elites must be extremely high.

"Correct, these are the weakest soldiers, the trash, those who are expendable. They are the weakest of the weak." She emphasized this point several times so that he would understand. These were only common soldiers! They were not elite or anything; they were merely the enemy’s cannon fodder!
"A detailed report of the first encounter with the 2 hostile factions is already here. You can see for yourself, Father."

Upon taking the golden sphere, the Heavenly Father began to study the things the Empire had given him. Seeing the report about Niklaus being kidnapped by tentacles, and about the fight involving Victor’s ’clone,’ he could say with certainty that he had completely underestimated these beings.
"What was that shot?" He felt that even he would not be able to withstand that attack head-on. At the very least, he would be severely injured.
"Velnorah says it is a solar system destroyer-class spaceship. It remains in the empty space between solar systems and attacks the very core of the star, decimating everything."
"These beings can casually wipe out an entire solar system..."

"Considering that the upper sectors have no limitations, meaning the cosmos are constantly expanding, they can afford to lose a few galaxies if necessary," Ariel spoke, disliking the scenario. After all, she valued life very much.

The Heavenly Father narrowed his eyes in the same way, sharing Ariel’s opinion on the matter. Losing a solar system was already bad enough, but throwing away an entire galaxy that possibly had trillions of lives within it?
That was already a bad joke.

"Not everything is bad, or the cosmos would be in complete anarchy with these beings invading the lower Sectors. Therefore, there must be some kind of order imposed by the primordials. We will only understand the whole scenario when we get there, but beforehand, understand that these are the types of enemies we will face. Take this into consideration when creating new angels."
"Understood, thank you for the warning, my daughter."
"You’re Welcome, Father." She smiled.

sentences.text: Chapter 1149: Heavenly Father, I Am Here to Visit.
In a vast plain made entirely of clouds, a simple house belonging to a simple villager was present.
Walking calmly toward that house was a woman with long blonde hair and green eyes, wearing divine armor.
Beside her was a woman who looked similar to her, with the only difference being that her hair was black and she had violet eyes.
"He changed the landscape again," Ariel murmured when she saw this place.
"Hmm, so this is your old house, Mother."
"Actually, this is my father’s house.
I didn’t stay around here much."
"I understand."
Ariella Victoria Elderblood received the name Ariella from her mother and Victoria from her father.
Ariella was born with immense power, like all of Victor’s daughters, and she almost completely inherited Victor’s black hair and violet eyes, but her face was more like her mother’s.
Born from the strongest female angel and the Dragon Emperor, Ariella was born with all 7 virtues of heaven, these same virtues being divine concepts that strengthened her.
Chastity, Charity, Temperance, Diligence, Patience, Benevolence, and Humility.
Not only that, but she was also born with traces of her father’s divinity of creation.
It could be said that she was a perfect angel, even if she wasn’t a complete angel.
"Hmm, I still prefer our house." She made a judgment.
"I miss my father...
Why am I here?
There’s nothing here...
Can I blow that up?
If I release a dragon breath, will it open a hole all the way to Yggdrasil?"
"Patience, daughter."
"Yes, Mother..." Ariella, with an impatient face, turned her head and began looking at the clouds, and more clouds.
In fact, there were only clouds and light here!
Her violet eyes glowed slightly.
She felt like blowing something up just to change the landscape here!
Ariel felt her head beginning to ache. ’How did this child inherit all 7 virtues of the angels?
She doesn’t practice any of these virtues!’ The worst part was that Ariel could only blame Victor.
After all, even if Ariella did not practice the 7 virtues, she would still retain her power, because, after all, she was a true dragon, a race that was compatible with all the powers of existence.
Even if Ariella were absolute evil, she would still have the 7 virtues, all because of her unique biology.
Upon reaching the simple house, Ariel was going to knock on the door gently, but the door had already opened, and a voice sounded: "Come in, my daughter."
Ariel wasted no time and entered the house, and as expected, it was a simple home, but a quite comfortable one.
"Father, it’s been a while."
The Heavenly Father looked at his daughter and smiled gently: "Indeed, my daughter, I see that you are doing well.
You have also become much stronger than before."
"Yes." Ariel smiled gently.
"Hmm...
Why are you glowing?
Are you my mother’s father?
Then you’re my grandfather...?
But why are you so weak?"
"Ariel!"
I’m sorry, Mother." She pouted and made a sulky face: "I’ll tell my father later." She muttered in a low voice, but everyone present heard it.
Ariel’s lips twitched, and the usual headache that all of Victor’s wives had returned. ’This is all Victor’s fault for spoiling them too much!’
"It’s okay, it’s okay, you don’t need to be so strict." The Heavenly Father easily realized she didn’t make those comments out of malice, but out of pure innocence.
She was like a newborn angel who was curious about everything around her.
In fact, not even angels were like this, considering that they were already born with knowledge.
It could be said that Ariella was truly very pure.
The Heavenly Father could not see even a trace of malice in her. ’They raised her very well.’ Just by looking at the girl, he could perceive how loved she was and the care of those around her.
"Answering your questions, compared to your father, all beings are very weak, including me, but my strengths are not in combat, but in creation.
I am a creator, you see." With a gesture of his hand, a swallow was created, and it gently landed on his hand.
Ariella’s eyes, which had been staring at the house in boredom, glowed slightly when she saw what he did.
"This is incredible!!!
You have perfect control over this, not even a single bit of energy was wasted.
I can’t do this."
Feeling a warm emotion blooming from those innocent eyes, he began to show off a little and started creating more animals.
"Ohhhh, incredible!!!"
At some point, the house, which had previously been cozy and comfortable, became a small Garden of Eden filled with small animals.
Ariel simply smiled gently while watching this scene, a scene she had never seen before with her father.
"You’re amazing, Grandpa."
"Practice makes perfect.
I had many years to perfect this craft." He explained gently.
"Even your father cannot surpass me when it comes to creation."
’Shit.’ Ariel immediately thought.
She looked at her daughter and sighed: ’As expected.’ She felt her headache returning.
Ariella’s eyes glowed a deep violet: "I doubt it.
My father is the best." She commented seriously.
"He created my sisters, Akasha, Metis, Melida, and even a bunch of women to help in the Empire!
Even several planets!" She defended him fervently.
’You may be a cool grandfather, but my father is the best!!!’ Just like her sisters, she was a strong defender of her father.
"...." The Heavenly Father’s lips twitched.
He easily realized that commenting about her father was like stepping on a very problematic armed mine.
Ariel quickly made an X with her arms, clearly telling him to change the subject.
"Let’s agree that both of us are amazing."
"My father is better!!!" Her eyes glowed even more intensely.
"Better!!!" As her eyes began to darken dangerously, the Heavenly Father genuinely began to sweat coldly.
He had already begun imagining the possible consequences if a fight happened here.
You’re right." And he gave up.
It was better to simply satisfy the child than deal with this political problem.
"Umu." She nodded, satisfied with a genuine smile on her face.
When she was about to say something, she saw something shiny in the corner, and that immediately caught her attention.
"Hmm?
Shine!!!" She ran in that direction and began playing with it.
Ariel broke into a cold sweat when she saw what her daughter was playing with.
It was the celestial system responsible for managing all the heavens!!!
"Ariell-"
"It’s okay.
I already disconnected the system from the dimension.
Nothing she does there will harm this place."
"I understand." Ariel sighed.
"I’m sorry about that, Father."
"It’s okay, hahaha." He laughed, amused.
"She is a kind child who is simply protecting her father; every child has this instinct within them."
That’s true."
"Hmm?
This is wrong.
Let’s do this, and this, and this, voilà...
Why isn’t it working?
What a bad system.
Akasha would get furious if she saw this.
Let’s modify this, and this...
What is a retro function?
It’s so old!" Ariella grumbled as she messed with the entire celestial system.

In fact, calling them modifications would be an insult.
She was practically writing a new source code from scratch.

If he sought to progress, he could have created something better.
Unlike the Empire, which was always improving itself, the Heavenly Father was stagnant.
If he so desired and put his genius toward creating and innovating, he would be unstoppable on the same level as Velnorah or even higher.
No matter how much potential you have, if you stop walking, other people will surpass you.
Her potential is unbelievable.
She would make a good successor."

chapters.title: Chapter 1150: Mother Kali, You Can’t!
paragraphs: Chapter 1150: Mother Kali, You Can’t!

A tall Dragon Goddess, 476 CM in height, walked in her divine red dress that looked more like a combination of a dress and armor than a proper dress. Her long red hair made of pure destruction reached down to her thighs, black-red horns proudly rested on her head, and her dragonic eyes showed pure indifference. Anything that came too close to her was completely destroyed from existence.

Except perhaps for another woman beside her, of similar height, but with long black-red hair made of pure destruction, black-violet horns, and deep violet eyes. Like the woman beside her, she wore a black divine dress with violet tones that looked more like armor than a proper dress, her curvy body an exact copy of the woman beside her. The two looked like twins, but to a keen observer, the differences were more than obvious.

The first woman was the Dragon Goddess of destruction, Kali Elderblood, wife of the Dragon Emperor, while the second was naturally her daughter Kassandra Kashvi Elderblood, daughter of Victor and Kali.

Kassandra was born different from her sisters. Due to her mother and father being two of the strongest beings alive, and both having powers of destruction, she was born as destruction itself. She was destruction incarnate. She achieved what her mother wanted to achieve simply by being born; genes really were unfair sometimes.

Upon being born, she had the aptitude to become a new Primordial of Destruction of the universe, but neither Kali nor even Victor wanted that for now, so she always remained hidden on their personal planet that was inside Victor’s soul. She was only allowed to leave when they managed to seal most of her power.

This seal functioned more like a limiter, similar to the one Victor had, rather than something that would harm her. After all, being born with so much power was also not a good thing. She had zero control over what, for example, her mother had in the concept of destruction. If Kassandra sneezed or even coughed and did not control herself, a planet could simply evaporate from existence.

And to make things ’better’, this wasn’t even all of her power. As a true dragon, even though she was born as the reincarnation of a concept, her predatory blood would not hold back. So what if she was a reincarnated concept? So what if she was the highest-order being? To her blood, none of that mattered as it completely devoured and assimilated it into her biology.

Consequently, Kassandra’s draconic powers carried all aspects of destruction itself. Even her reality alteration performed through the draconic language carried massive damage. If she wanted to erase someone from existence, she simply needed to speak. And this did not only apply to beings, as anything could be erased if she so desired, and all of this used very little energy. It could be said that she had completely specialized in attack since birth.

Victor could only sigh in relief that she had not been born with the concept of END. If Kassandra had been born with this ability, she would not simply erase someone but would delete that person from existence forever, as if they had never existed.

Destruction did not completely erase everything as if it had never existed, erasing even that person from time and space and the Akashic Records. It simply recycled it so that creation could use that matter, but END was not like that. END was true conceptual erasure, and the record of its existence would simply cease to exist.

Kassandra also had Victor’s eyes, just like all of his daughters, and she was born with traces of the concept of Negativity as well, allowing her, just like her father, to progress with this concept in the future. Genes really were something unfair. Some people struggled and suffered to reach such a level of power, while others simply were born at the top.

For Kassandra, such a thing had no importance. She would follow everything her father wanted, since she knew that he only wanted the best for her. The most important thing for her was that she had received the gloves Victor used when he was younger to limit his power!!!

A gift she cherished immensely, and a gift that always made her sisters jealous. Kassandra raised her hand once more and affectionately caressed the gloves, holding herself back from smiling completely.
’My father used these when he was much younger, and he gave them to me!!!’ She always jumped mentally when she thought about it.

Seeing this beside her, Kali held herself back from rolling her eyes. Kali’s opinion on the matter was complicated. She was shocked that her daughter had achieved what she wanted to achieve simply by being born, and she was a little envious. She wouldn’t lie, but above all, she was happy that her daughter had been born strong and healthy. For a mother, above all, that was what mattered most.
[Control yourself, My Daughter.]
Hearing her mother’s voice, Kassandra quickly lowered her hand and assumed her princessly posture: [... Yes, Mother.]

Arriving near Shiva’s temple, the guards did not even try to stop them. First, simply approaching them would erase their existence, and second, they knew Kali, and they knew very well that her status was even more special than before.

As for the woman beside her, they were not fools. They had eyes, and it was obvious that this woman must be Kali’s daughter, considering that she shared similarities with Kali and the Dragon Emperor himself.
One of the reasons the Imperial Wife and the Emperor’s daughter were coming to the Hindu territory was the same reason Ariel went to visit the Heavenly Father.
As subjects of the Empire, the appropriate reaction should be for them to receive his call, but just because things were this way did not mean they were correct.

First, Victor married Kali and Ariel in a political alliance, and therefore, he would honor this alliance. Victor’s stance had always been clear from the beginning: an eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth, and blood for blood. Having the Imperial wives, along with their daughters, on this visit demonstrated his appreciation for the alliance, regardless of their personal thoughts.

And besides that, they were not unprotected, though Victor doubted that anyone would be capable of restraining Kali or even her daughter. Still, as an always overprotective man, he sent several hidden forces to protect the two, most of these forces being the family’s own Imperial Guard and Victor’s Eldritch subordinates. Ariel and her daughter Ariella received the same treatment when they went to visit the Heavenly Father, both of them being completely protected.

’Strange, in the past, when I thought that a possible war between my husband and my pantheon could happen, my answer would always be that I would protect my pantheon, but now... The answer is more difficult.’ Kali thought. She genuinely liked her current family. She had several beautiful daughters, sisters who understood her, and a husband who cared about her. Therefore, if a war happened between Shiva and Victor, she would be completely divided over what to do.
On one side was her pantheon, where she had grown up for most of her life, and on the other was her loving family. Therefore, she hoped to maintain cordiality between the two.

’Although a war with my husband would be pure foolishness.’ Sentimentality aside, if her friend decided to go to war even after seeing the parade, forget Victor, she would beat Shiva up herself so that he would wake up to reality.
Entering Shiva’s temple, she saw her friend sitting on the throne. He looked much older since the last time he had seen her.

"Lady Kali... What a surprise that you are here." Since both were in an official setting, he addressed her respectfully. Shiva looked at Kali for a moment, who looked very different from before, with a complex expression. His friend had truly changed a lot.

Kali narrowed her eyes slightly. Her dragon eyes read the god in front of her, and she saw that he was merely tired, something that made no sense considering what kind of being he was. Who could possibly tire him out?
"Lord Shiva, why do you look so tired?" Kali couldn’t contain herself and asked.
"... Well, my wife Parvati has been somewhat competitive recently due to the actions of Lady Aphrodite and her subordinates."

"Ah..." Kali understood now, ’Not everyone can be Victor, huh.’ She couldn’t help but think this when she saw Shiva’s condition. How could a god of his caliber become tired? It was true that Parvati was not exactly weak, but did this make sense? She remembered hearing a report that Shiva had recently had more children. Could that be the reason?
Kali decided it was wiser not to question this and simply move on.

If Ariel and the Heavenly Father’s environment was more like a daughter returning home, the environment between Kali and Shiva was much more formal, since other gods were present. But even though they were visibly only two people, the presence of Kali and Kassandra made everyone present feel an existential weight.

It was like trying to look at something incomprehensible, trying to understand them and failing miserably, which was absurd. Weren’t they all gods? Why were Kali and this woman so different? The gods present could not help but feel uneasy and uncomfortable.

Returning to more official matters, Kali set aside her emotions in her speech and spoke: "My name is Kali Elderblood, Dragon Goddess of destruction of the Empire, and wife of the Dragon Emperor Victor Elderblood, and this one beside me is the Imperial Princess Kassandra Kashvi Elderblood, my and the Emperor’s daughter."
For a moment, not only Shiva but all the gods present looked more calculatingly at the woman beside Kali. She was beautiful and powerful, perhaps...

Kassandra’s face visibly distorted into something horrifying, and just as she was about to say something, her mother intervened. If her daughter said something now, forget the alliance; this entire temple would turn to dust. She knew very well how aggressive her daughter was.

"I suggest you do not continue that thought." Kali’s entire presence battered the temple as if gravity had suddenly increased. As space itself around her began to be slowly destroyed, and this was with her simply easing her control on holding herself back.
"Such thoughts toward the Imperial family are inappropriate, if not insulting. The princesses have the right to decide whatever they want about their destiny. This is the Emperor’s will."
[Calm down.] She ordered her daughter.
[... But Mother.]
[I said calm down.] She spoke with a stronger mother’s tone.
[... I will tell my father about this.] She grumbled, but obeyed and stopped producing her powers.
Kali held herself back greatly from reacting to these words, ’These spoiled daughters! It’s all your fault, Victor!!!’
This phrase had become a common consensus among Victor’s wives by this point.

Shiva looked at the other gods and narrowed his eyes. Being present with two Dragon Goddesses who could read emotions alongside these fools would only put him at a disadvantage. Shiva remembered very well the first meeting he had with Victor present. If his daughter had even 1% of his talent for reading emotions, he did not want any fools nearby: "Leave."
"Yes, Your Majesty."
’I should have done this before.’ He grumbled internally. He blamed his wife for this, because why was she competitive with Aphrodite anyway?
When the gods left, Shiva spoke: "I apologize for this, Kali."
"It’s alright, I understand how they work."
Without other gods nearby, they could be more friendly, like the old friends they were.
"..." Kassandra looked at her mother and Shiva with narrowed eyes.

[Mother, if you are cheating on my father, I will report you. I will not remain silent. What you are doing is wrong, and worse yet, you are choosing such a bad man. You are blind!] She accused her immediately and without remorse.
Veins popped on Kali’s head, and she looked at her daughter with irritation: [Stop thinking nonsense! Do you think I am that kind of woman!?]
[Then why are you being so friendly with another man? You can’t! You are my father’s wife! If you betray him, I will stand by my father without even thinking twice!]
Kali was holding herself back very much at this moment from pulling out the belt and beating this insolent daughter.
[He is my longtime friend.] She explained.

[Impossible, there is no such thing as a male friend. Mother Aphrodite and Mother Pepper told me that male friends are just hiding their intentions to sleep with you, and you are so beautiful, Mother. This is all a trap!!! Don’t fall for it!]
Kali clenched her fists and solemnly promised to teach Pepper and Aphrodite a lesson. They were not wrong, but they were not right either, since exceptions existed.
Kali looked at Shiva, and she remembered the time when he tried to court her... And wisely decided to leave that matter aside. Aphrodite and Pepper were not wrong.
[Mother, wake up to reality!!!] Kassandra did not give up.
[Enough, stay quiet!!!] Kali really had a headache now.
"...." Kassandra obeyed, but her gaze said that this would not be the end.

Kali already regretted bringing her daughter here. Her daughter, Kassandra, was in the faction of daughters who were completely irrational regarding their father. This faction did not even tolerate their mothers looking at other men the wrong way. She was an extremist from beginning to end. For her, bringing Ariella or Liliana would be better, as they were the daughters who belonged to the less extreme faction.
Feeling her mother’s regret about bringing her here, Kassandra opened her eyes in shock. "Mother, you-..."
More veins popped on her head, her power increased, and she forced a smile: "Give me just a few minutes, Shiva. I’ll be right back."
"... Alright." Even though he did not understand, he agreed.
Kali grabbed her daughter by the arm, used her draconic language powers to bend reality, and brought her into a dimension she quickly created.
"Even if you hit me, I won’t stay silent!!!" Kassandra rebelled.
"You are an insolent daughter. Do you think I am that kind of woman!? I love your father with my life!"
"Then why are you talking to another man!? You can’t! You should only talk like that with my father!!!"
"Silence! You will learn to respect your mother!!!" Kali created a belt of pure destruction and snapped it with her hand.
"Ugyaaaaaaaaahhhhhhh!"

She would follow everything her father wanted, since she knew that he only wanted the best for her.
The most important thing for her was that she had received the gloves Victor used when he was younger to limit his power!!!
A gift she cherished immensely, and a gift that always made her sisters jealous.
Kassandra raised her hand once more and affectionately caressed the gloves, holding herself back from smiling completely.
’My father used these when he was much younger, and he gave them to me!!!’ She always jumped mentally when she thought about it.
Seeing this beside her, Kali held herself back from rolling her eyes.
Kali’s opinion on the matter was complicated.
She was shocked that her daughter had achieved what she wanted to achieve simply by being born, and she was a little envious.
She wouldn’t lie, but above all, she was happy that her daughter had been born strong and healthy.
For a mother, above all, that was what mattered most.
[Control yourself, My Daughter.]
Hearing her mother’s voice, Kassandra quickly lowered her hand and assumed her princessly posture: [...
Yes, Mother.]
Arriving near Shiva’s temple, the guards did not even try to stop them.
First, simply approaching them would erase their existence, and second, they knew Kali, and they knew very well that her status was even more special than before.
As for the woman beside her, they were not fools.
They had eyes, and it was obvious that this woman must be Kali’s daughter, considering that she shared similarities with Kali and the Dragon Emperor himself.
One of the reasons the Imperial Wife and the Emperor’s daughter were coming to the Hindu territory was the same reason Ariel went to visit the Heavenly Father.
As subjects of the Empire, the appropriate reaction should be for them to receive his call, but just because things were this way did not mean they were correct.
First, Victor married Kali and Ariel in a political alliance, and therefore, he would honor this alliance.
Victor’s stance had always been clear from the beginning: an eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth, and blood for blood.
Having the Imperial wives, along with their daughters, on this visit demonstrated his appreciation for the alliance, regardless of their personal thoughts.
And besides that, they were not unprotected, though Victor doubted that anyone would be capable of restraining Kali or even her daughter.
Still, as an always overprotective man, he sent several hidden forces to protect the two, most of these forces being the family’s own Imperial Guard and Victor’s Eldritch subordinates.
Ariel and her daughter Ariella received the same treatment when they went to visit the Heavenly Father, both of them being completely protected.
’Strange, in the past, when I thought that a possible war between my husband and my pantheon could happen, my answer would always be that I would protect my pantheon, but now...
The answer is more difficult.’ Kali thought.
She genuinely liked her current family.
She had several beautiful daughters, sisters who understood her, and a husband who cared about her.
Therefore, if a war happened between Shiva and Victor, she would be completely divided over what to do.
On one side was her pantheon, where she had grown up for most of her life, and on the other was her loving family.
Therefore, she hoped to maintain cordiality between the two.

’Although a war with my husband would be pure foolishness.’ Sentimentality aside, if her friend decided to go to war even after seeing the parade, forget Victor, she would beat Shiva up herself so that he would wake up to reality.
Entering Shiva’s temple, she saw her friend sitting on the throne.
He looked much older since the last time he had seen her.
"Lady Kali...
What a surprise that you are here." Since both were in an official setting, he addressed her respectfully.
Shiva looked at Kali for a moment, who looked very different from before, with a complex expression.
His friend had truly changed a lot.
Kali narrowed her eyes slightly.
Her dragon eyes read the god in front of her, and she saw that he was merely tired, something that made no sense considering what kind of being he was.
Who could possibly tire him out?
"Lord Shiva, why do you look so tired?" Kali couldn’t contain herself and asked.
Well, my wife Parvati has been somewhat competitive recently due to the actions of Lady Aphrodite and her subordinates."
"Ah..." Kali understood now, ’Not everyone can be Victor, huh.’ She couldn’t help but think this when she saw Shiva’s condition.
How could a god of his caliber become tired?
It was true that Parvati was not exactly weak, but did this make sense?
She remembered hearing a report that Shiva had recently had more children.
Could that be the reason?
Kali decided it was wiser not to question this and simply move on.
If Ariel and the Heavenly Father’s environment was more like a daughter returning home, the environment between Kali and Shiva was much more formal, since other gods were present.
But even though they were visibly only two people, the presence of Kali and Kassandra made everyone present feel an existential weight.
It was like trying to look at something incomprehensible, trying to understand them and failing miserably, which was absurd.
Weren’t they all gods?
Why were Kali and this woman so different?
The gods present could not help but feel uneasy and uncomfortable.

Returning to more official matters, Kali set aside her emotions in her speech and spoke: "My name is Kali Elderblood, Dragon Goddess of destruction of the Empire, and wife of the Dragon Emperor Victor Elderblood, and this one beside me is the Imperial Princess Kassandra Kashvi Elderblood, my and the Emperor’s daughter."
For a moment, not only Shiva but all the gods present looked more calculatingly at the woman beside Kali.
She was beautiful and powerful, perhaps...
Kassandra’s face visibly distorted into something horrifying, and just as she was about to say something, her mother intervened.
If her daughter said something now, forget the alliance; this entire temple would turn to dust.
She knew very well how aggressive her daughter was.
"I suggest you do not continue that thought." Kali’s entire presence battered the temple as if gravity had suddenly increased.
As space itself around her began to be slowly destroyed, and this was with her simply easing her control on holding herself back.
"Such thoughts toward the Imperial family are inappropriate, if not insulting.
The princesses have the right to decide whatever they want about their destiny.
This is the Emperor’s will."
[Calm down.] She ordered her daughter.
But Mother.]
[I said calm down.] She spoke with a stronger mother’s tone.
I will tell my father about this.] She grumbled, but obeyed and stopped producing her powers.
Kali held herself back greatly from reacting to these words, ’These spoiled daughters!
It’s all your fault, Victor!!!’
This phrase had become a common consensus among Victor’s wives by this point.
Shiva looked at the other gods and narrowed his eyes.
Being present with two Dragon Goddesses who could read emotions alongside these fools would only put him at a disadvantage.
Shiva remembered very well the first meeting he had with Victor present.
If his daughter had even 1% of his talent for reading emotions, he did not want any fools nearby: "Leave."
"Yes, Your Majesty."
’I should have done this before.’ He grumbled internally.
He blamed his wife for this, because why was she competitive with Aphrodite anyway?
When the gods left, Shiva spoke: "I apologize for this, Kali."
"It’s alright, I understand how they work."
Without other gods nearby, they could be more friendly, like the old friends they were.
"..." Kassandra looked at her mother and Shiva with narrowed eyes.
[Mother, if you are cheating on my father, I will report you.
I will not remain silent.
What you are doing is wrong, and worse yet, you are choosing such a bad man.
You are blind!] She accused her immediately and without remorse.
Veins popped on Kali’s head, and she looked at her daughter with irritation: [Stop thinking nonsense!
Do you think I am that kind of woman!?]
[Then why are you being so friendly with another man?
You can’t!
You are my father’s wife!
If you betray him, I will stand by my father without even thinking twice!]
Kali was holding herself back very much at this moment from pulling out the belt and beating this insolent daughter.
[He is my longtime friend.] She explained.
[Impossible, there is no such thing as a male friend.
Mother Aphrodite and Mother Pepper told me that male friends are just hiding their intentions to sleep with you, and you are so beautiful, Mother.
This is all a trap!!!
Don’t fall for it!]
Kali clenched her fists and solemnly promised to teach Pepper and Aphrodite a lesson.
They were not wrong, but they were not right either, since exceptions existed.
Kali looked at Shiva, and she remembered the time when he tried to court her...
And wisely decided to leave that matter aside.
Aphrodite and Pepper were not wrong.
[Mother, wake up to reality!!!] Kassandra did not give up.
[Enough, stay quiet!!!] Kali really had a headache now.
"...." Kassandra obeyed, but her gaze said that this would not be the end.
Kali already regretted bringing her daughter here.
Her daughter, Kassandra, was in the faction of daughters who were completely irrational regarding their father.
This faction did not even tolerate their mothers looking at other men the wrong way.
She was an extremist from beginning to end.
For her, bringing Ariella or Liliana would be better, as they were the daughters who belonged to the less extreme faction.
Feeling her mother’s regret about bringing her here, Kassandra opened her eyes in shock.
"Mother, you-..."
More veins popped on her head, her power increased, and she forced a smile: "Give me just a few minutes, Shiva.
I’ll be right back."
Alright." Even though he did not understand, he agreed.
Kali grabbed her daughter by the arm, used her draconic language powers to bend reality, and brought her into a dimension she quickly created.
"Even if you hit me, I won’t stay silent!!!" Kassandra rebelled.
"You are an insolent daughter.
Do you think I am that kind of woman!?
I love your father with my life!"
"Then why are you talking to another man!?
You can’t!
You should only talk like that with my father!!!"
"Silence!
You will learn to respect your mother!!!" Kali created a belt of pure destruction and snapped it with her hand.
"Ugyaaaaaaaaahhhhhhh!"
